141uint32_t CS3Trio64::latch_start_addr()
142{
143 if (s3.memory_config & 0x08)
144 {
145 // - SDD scrolling test expects a << 2 for 8bpp and no shift for anything else
146 // - Slackware 3.x XF86_S3 expect a << 2 shift (to be confirmed)
147 // - przonegd expect no shift (RGB16)
148 return vga.crtc.start_addr_latch << (svga.rgb8_en ? 2 : 0);
149 }
150 return vga.crtc.start_addr_latch;
151}

170void CS3Trio64::s3_define_video_mode()
171{
172 int divisor = 1;
173 int xtal = ((vga.miscellaneous_output & 0xc) ? XTAL(28'636'363) : XTAL(25'174'800)).value();
174 double freq;
175
176 if ((vga.miscellaneous_output & 0xc) == 0x0c)
177 {
178 // DCLK calculation
179 freq = ((double)(s3.clk_pll_m + 2) / (double)((s3.clk_pll_n + 2) * (pow(2.0, s3.clk_pll_r)))) * 14.318; // clock between XIN and XOUT
180 xtal = freq * 1000000;
181 }
182
183 if ((s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2) >> 4)
184 {
185 svga.rgb8_en = 0;
186 svga.rgb15_en = 0;
187 svga.rgb16_en = 0;
188 svga.rgb32_en = 0;
189 // FIXME: vision864 has only first 7 modes
190 switch ((s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2) >> 4)
191 {
192 // 0001 Mode 8: 2x 8-bit 1 VCLK/2 pixels
193 case 0x01: svga.rgb8_en = 1; break;
194 // 0010 Mode 1: 15-bit 2 VCLK/pixel
195 case 0x02: svga.rgb15_en = 1; break;
196 // 0011 Mode 9: 15-bit 1 VCLK/pixel
197 case 0x03: svga.rgb15_en = 1; divisor = 2; break;
198 // 0100 Mode 2: 24-bit 3 VCLK/pixel
199 case 0x04: svga.rgb24_en = 1; break;
200 // 0101 Mode 10: 16-bit 1 VCLK/pixel
201 case 0x05: svga.rgb16_en = 1; divisor = 2; break;
202 // 0110 Mode 3: 16-bit 2 VCLK/pixel
203 case 0x06: svga.rgb16_en = 1; break;
204 // 0111 Mode 11: 24/32-bit 2 VCLK/pixel
205 case 0x07: svga.rgb32_en = 1; divisor = 4; break;
206 case 0x0d: svga.rgb32_en = 1; divisor = 1; break;
207 default:
208 printf("%s: Unsupported pixel color mode %02x.\n", devid_string, ((s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2) >> 4));
209 break;
210 }
211 }
212 else
213 {
214 // 0000: Mode 0 8-bit 1 VCLK/pixel
215 svga.rgb8_en = (s3.memory_config & 8) >> 3;
216 svga.rgb15_en = 0;
217 svga.rgb16_en = 0;
218 svga.rgb32_en = 0;
219 }
220
221#ifdef DEBUG_VGA_RENDER
222 LOGCRTC("%s: define_video_mode: ext_misc_ctrl_2=%02x memory_config=%02x "
223 "rgb8=%d rgb15=%d rgb16=%d rgb32=%d crtc_offset=%03x offset()=%d\n",
224 devid_string, s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2, s3.memory_config,
225 svga.rgb8_en, svga.rgb15_en, svga.rgb16_en, svga.rgb32_en,
226 vga.crtc.offset, offset());
227#endif
228
229 recompute_params_clock(divisor, xtal);
230}

232void CS3Trio64::refresh_pitch_offset()
233{
234 // bit 2 = bit 8 of offset register, but only if bits 4-5 of CR51 are 00h.
235 vga.crtc.offset &= 0xff;
236 if ((s3.cr51 & 0x30) == 0)
237 vga.crtc.offset |= (s3.cr43 & 0x04) << 6;
238 else
239 vga.crtc.offset |= (s3.cr51 & 0x30) << 4;
240}

242void CS3Trio64::crtc_map(address_map& map)
243{
244 svga_device::crtc_map(map);
245
246 // ES40 redraw notifications for the text cursor and display start.
247 map(0x0a, 0x0a).lw8(
248 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
249 vga.crtc.cursor_enable = ((data & 0x20) ^ 0x20) >> 5;
250 vga.crtc.cursor_scan_start = data & 0x1f;
251 state.vga_mem_updated = 1;
252 })
253 );
254 map(0x0b, 0x0b).lw8(
255 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
256 vga.crtc.cursor_skew = (data & 0x60) >> 5;
257 vga.crtc.cursor_scan_end = data & 0x1f;
258 state.vga_mem_updated = 1;
259 })
260 );
261 map(0x0c, 0x0d).lw8(
262 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
263 vga.crtc.start_addr_latch &= ~(0xff << (((offset & 1) ^ 1) * 8));
264 vga.crtc.start_addr_latch |= (data << (((offset & 1) ^ 1) * 8));
265 state.vga_mem_updated = 1;
266 })
267 );
268 map(0x0e, 0x0f).lw8(
269 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
270 vga.crtc.cursor_addr &= ~(0xff << (((offset & 1) ^ 1) * 8));
271 vga.crtc.cursor_addr |= (data << (((offset & 1) ^ 1) * 8));
272 state.vga_mem_updated = 1;
273 })
274 );
275 map(0x2d, 0x2d).lr8(
276 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
277 return s3.id_high;
278 })
279 );
280 map(0x2e, 0x2e).lr8(
281 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
282 return s3.id_low;
283 })
284 );
285 map(0x2f, 0x2f).lr8(
286 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
287 return s3.revision;
288 })
289 );
290 // CR30 Chip ID/REV register
291 map(0x30, 0x30).lr8(
292 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
293 return s3.id_cr30;
294 })
295 );
296 // CR31 Memory Configuration Register
297 map(0x31, 0x31).lrw8(
298 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
299 return s3.memory_config;
300 }),
301 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
302 s3.memory_config = data;
303 vga.crtc.start_addr_latch &= ~0x30000;
304 vga.crtc.start_addr_latch |= ((data & 0x30) << 12);
305 s3_define_video_mode();
306 })
307 );
308 // TODO: CR32, CR33 & CR34 (backward compatibility) - in our ES40 we do these ! :)
309 // CR32: Backward Compatibility 1 (BKWD_1)
310 map(0x32, 0x32).lrw8(
311 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
312 return s3.cr32;
313 }),
314 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
315 s3.cr32 = data;
316 })
317 );
318 // CR33: Backward Compatibility 2 (BKWD_2)
319 map(0x33, 0x33).lrw8(
320 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
321 return s3.cr33;
322 }),
323 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
324 s3.cr33 = data;
325 // ES40 extension: CR33 bit5 forces 8-dot chars
326 recompute_scanline_layout();
327 state.vga_mem_updated = 1;
328 })
329 );
330 // CR34: Backward Compatibility 3 (BKWD_3)
331 map(0x34, 0x34).lrw8(
332 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
333 return s3.cr34;
334 }),
335 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
336 s3.cr34 = data;
337 })
338 );
339 map(0x35, 0x35).lrw8(
340 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
341 return s3.crt_reg_lock;
342 }),
343 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
344 // lock register
345 if ((s3.reg_lock1 & 0xc) != 8 || ((s3.reg_lock1 & 0xc0) == 0))
346 return;
347 s3.crt_reg_lock = data;
348 svga.bank_w = data & 0xf;
349 svga.bank_r = svga.bank_w;
350 })
351 );
352 // Configuration register 1
353 map(0x36, 0x36).lrw8(
354 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
355 // PCI (not really), Fast Page Mode DRAM
356 return s3.strapping & 0x000000ff;
357 }),
358 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
359 if (s3.reg_lock2 == 0xa5)
360 {
361 s3.strapping = (s3.strapping & 0xffffff00) | data;
362 LOG("%s: CR36: Strapping data = %08x\n", devid_string, s3.strapping);
363 }
364 })
365 );
366 // Configuration register 2
367 map(0x37, 0x37).lrw8(
368 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
369 return (s3.strapping & 0x0000ff00) >> 8; // enable chipset, 64k BIOS size, internal DCLK/MCLK
370 }),
371 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
372 // TODO: monitor ID at 7-5 (PD15-13)
373 if (s3.reg_lock2 == 0xa5)
374 {
375 s3.strapping = (s3.strapping & 0xffff00ff) | (data << 8);
376 LOG("%s: CR37: Strapping data = %08x\n", devid_string, s3.strapping);
377 }
378 })
379 );
380 map(0x38, 0x38).lrw8(
381 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
382 return s3.reg_lock1;
383 }),
384 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
385 s3.reg_lock1 = data;
386 })
387 );
388 map(0x39, 0x39).lrw8(
389 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
390 return s3.reg_lock2;
391 }),
392 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
393 // TODO: reg lock mechanism
394 s3.reg_lock2 = data;
395 })
396 );
397 // CR3A: Miscellaneous 1 Register (MISC_1)
398 map(0x3a, 0x3a).lrw8(
399 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
400 return s3.cr3a;
401 }),
402 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
403 s3.cr3a = data;
404 })
405 );
406 // CR3B: Data Transfer Position (DT_EX-POS)
407 map(0x3b, 0x3b).lrw8(
408 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
409 return s3.cr3b;
410 }),
411 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
412 s3.cr3b = data;
413 })
414 );
415 // CR3C: Interlace Retrace Start (IL_RTSTART)
416 map(0x3c, 0x3c).lrw8(
417 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
418 return s3.cr3c;
419 }),
420 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
421 s3.cr3c = data;
422 })
423 );
424 // CR40: System Configuration Register (SYS_CNFG)
425 map(0x40, 0x40).lrw8(
426 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
427 return s3.cr40;
428 }),
429 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
430 s3.cr40 = data;
431 // enable 8514/A registers (x2e8, x6e8, xae8, xee8)
432 s3.enable_8514 = BIT(data, 0);
433 })
434 );
435 // CR41
436 map(0x41, 0x41).lrw8(
437 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
438 return s3.cr41;
439 }),
440 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
441 s3.cr41 = data;
442 })
443 );
444 // CR42 Mode Control
445 map(0x42, 0x42).lrw8(
446 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
447 return s3.cr42;
448 }),
449 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
450 // bit 5 = interlace, bits 0-3 = dot clock (seems to be undocumented)
451 s3.cr42 = data;
452 s3_define_video_mode();
453 })
454 );
455 map(0x43, 0x43).lrw8(
456 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
457 return s3.cr43;
458 }),
459 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
460 s3.cr43 = data; // bit 2 = bit 8 of offset register, but only if bits 4-5 of CR51 are 00h.
461 refresh_pitch_offset();
462 s3_define_video_mode();
463 })
464 );
465 /*
466 CR45 Hardware Graphics Cursor Mode
467 bit 0 HWGC ENB. Hardware Graphics Cursor Enable. Set to enable the
468 HardWare Cursor in VGA and enhanced modes.
469 1 (911/24) Delay Timing for Pattern Data Fetch
470 2 (801/5,928) Hardware Cursor Horizontal Stretch 2. If set the cursor
471 pixels are stretched horizontally to two bytes and items 0 and 1 of
472 the fore/background stacks in 3d4h index 4Ah/4Bh are used.
473 3 (801/5,928) Hardware Cursor Horizontal Stretch 3. If set the cursor
474 pixels are stretched horizontally to three bytes and items 0,1 and
475 2 of the fore/background stacks in 3d4h index 4Ah/4Bh are used.
476 2-3 (805i,864/964) HWC-CSEL. Hardware Cursor Color Select.
477 0: 4/8bit, 1: 15/16bt, 2: 24bit, 3: 32bit
478 Note: So far I've had better luck with: 0: 8/15/16bit, 1: 32bit??
479 4 (80x +) Hardware Cursor Right Storage. If set the cursor data is
480 stored in the last 256 bytes of 4 1Kyte lines (4bits/pixel) or the
481 last 512 bytes of 2 2Kbyte lines (8bits/pixel). Intended for
482 1280x1024 modes where there are no free lines at the bottom.
483 5 (928) Cursor Control Enable for Brooktree Bt485 DAC. If set and 3d4h
484 index 55h bit 5 is set the HC1 output becomes the ODF and the HC0
485 output becomes the CDE
486 (964) BT485 ODF Selection for Bt485A RAMDAC. If set pin 185 (RS3
487 /ODF) is the ODF output to a Bt485A compatible RamDAC (low for even
488 fields and high for odd fields), if clear pin185 is the RS3 output.
489 */
490 map(0x45, 0x45).lrw8(
491 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
492 const u8 res = s3.cursor_mode;
493 if (!machine().side_effects_disabled())
494 {
495 s3.cursor_fg_ptr = 0;
496 s3.cursor_bg_ptr = 0;
497 }
498 return res;
499 }),
500 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
501 s3.cursor_mode = data;
502 })
503 );
504 /*
505 CR46/7 Hardware Graphics Cursor Origin-X
506 bit 0-10 The HardWare Cursor X position. For 64k modes this value should be
507 twice the actual X co-ordinate.
508 */
509 map(0x46, 0x46).lrw8(
510 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
511 return (s3.cursor_x & 0xff00) >> 8;
512 }),
513 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
514 s3.cursor_x = (s3.cursor_x & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
515 })
516 );
517 map(0x47, 0x47).lrw8(
518 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
519 return s3.cursor_x & 0x00ff;
520 }),
521 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
522 s3.cursor_x = (s3.cursor_x & 0xff00) | data;
523 })
524 );
525 /*
526 CR48/9 Hardware Graphics Cursor Origin-Y
527 bit 0-9 (911/24) The HardWare Cursor Y position.
528 0-10 (80x +) The HardWare Cursor Y position.
529 Note: The position is activated when the high byte of the Y coordinate (index
530 48h) is written, so this byte should be written last (not 911/924 ?)
531 */
532 map(0x48, 0x48).lrw8(
533 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
534 return (s3.cursor_y & 0xff00) >> 8;
535 }),
536 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
537 s3.cursor_y = (s3.cursor_y & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
538 })
539 );
540 map(0x49, 0x49).lrw8(
541 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
542 return s3.cursor_y & 0x00ff;
543 }),
544 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
545 s3.cursor_y = (s3.cursor_y & 0xff00) | data;
546 })
547 );
548 /*
549 CR4A Hardware Graphics Cursor Foreground Stack (80x +)
550 bit 0-7 The Foreground Cursor color. Three bytes (4 for the 864/964) are
551 stacked here. When the Cursor Mode register (3d4h index 45h) is read
552 the stackpointer is reset. When a byte is written the byte is
553 written into the current top of stack and the stackpointer is
554 increased. The first byte written (item 0) is allways used, the
555 other two(3) only when Hardware Cursor Horizontal Stretch (3d4h
556 index 45h bit 2-3) is enabled.
557 */
558 map(0x4a, 0x4a).lrw8(
559 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
560 const u8 res = s3.cursor_fg[s3.cursor_fg_ptr];
561 if (!machine().side_effects_disabled())
562 {
563 s3.cursor_fg_ptr++;
564 s3.cursor_fg_ptr %= 4;
565 }
566 return res;
567 }),
568 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
569 s3.cursor_fg[s3.cursor_fg_ptr++] = data;
570 s3.cursor_fg_ptr %= 4;
571 })
572 );
573 /*
574 CR4B Hardware Graphics Cursor Background Stack (80x +)
575 bit 0-7 The Background Cursor color. Three bytes (4 for the 864/964) are
576 stacked here. When the Cursor Mode register (3d4h index 45h) is read
577 the stackpointer is reset. When a byte is written the byte is
578 written into the current top of stack and the stackpointer is
579 increased. The first byte written (item 0) is allways used, the
580 other two(3) only when Hardware Cursor Horizontal Stretch (3d4h
581 index 45h bit 2-3) is enabled.
582 */
583 map(0x4b, 0x4b).lrw8(
584 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
585 const u8 res = s3.cursor_bg[s3.cursor_bg_ptr];
586 if (!machine().side_effects_disabled())
587 {
588 s3.cursor_bg_ptr++;
589 s3.cursor_bg_ptr %= 4;
590 }
591 return res;
592 }),
593 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
594 s3.cursor_bg[s3.cursor_bg_ptr++] = data;
595 s3.cursor_bg_ptr %= 4;
596 })
597 );
598 /*
599 CR4C/D Hardware Graphics Cursor Storage Start Address
600 bit 0-9 (911,924) HCS_STADR. Hardware Graphics Cursor Storage Start Address
601 0-11 (80x,928) HWGC_STA. Hardware Graphics Cursor Storage Start Address
602 0-12 (864,964) HWGC_STA. Hardware Graphics Cursor Storage Start Address
603 Address of the HardWare Cursor Map in units of 1024 bytes (256 bytes
604 for planar modes). The cursor map is a 64x64 bitmap with 2 bits (A
605 and B) per pixel. The map is stored as one word (16 bits) of bit A,
606 followed by one word with the corresponding 16 B bits.
607 The bits are interpreted as:
608 A B MS-Windows: X-11:
609 0 0 Background Screen data
610 0 1 Foreground Screen data
611 1 0 Screen data Background
612 1 1 Inverted screen Foreground
613 The Windows/X11 switch is only available for the 80x +.
614 (911/24) For 64k color modes the cursor is stored as one byte (8
615 bits) of A bits, followed by the 8 B-bits, and each bit in the
616 cursor should be doubled to provide a consistent cursor image.
617 (801/5,928) For Hi/True color modes use the Horizontal Stretch bits
618 (3d4h index 45h bits 2 and 3).
619 */
620 map(0x4c, 0x4c).lrw8(
621 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
622 return (s3.cursor_start_addr & 0xff00) >> 8;
623 }),
624 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
625 s3.cursor_start_addr = (s3.cursor_start_addr & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
626 })
627 );
628 map(0x4d, 0x4d).lrw8(
629 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
630 return s3.cursor_start_addr & 0x00ff;
631 }),
632 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
633 s3.cursor_start_addr = (s3.cursor_start_addr & 0xff00) | data;
634 })
635 );
636 /*
637 CR4E HGC Pattern Disp Start X-Pixel Position
638 bit 0-5 Pattern Display Start X-Pixel Position.
639 */
640 map(0x4e, 0x4e).lrw8(
641 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
642 return s3.cursor_pattern_x;
643 }),
644 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
645 s3.cursor_pattern_x = data;
646 })
647 );
648 /*
649 CR4F HGC Pattern Disp Start Y-Pixel Position
650 bit 0-5 Pattern Display Start Y-Pixel Position.
651 */
652 map(0x4f, 0x4f).lrw8(
653 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
654 return s3.cursor_pattern_y;
655 }),
656 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
657 s3.cursor_pattern_y = data;
658 })
659 );
660 // CR50
661 map(0x50, 0x50).lrw8(
662 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
663 return s3.cr50;
664 }),
665 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
666 s3.cr50 = data;
667 ibm8514a_device* dev = get_8514();
668 dev->ibm8514.color_bpp = (data >> 4) & 3;
669 })
670 );
671 map(0x51, 0x51).lrw8(
672 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
673 u8 res = (vga.crtc.start_addr_latch & 0x0c0000) >> 18;
674 res |= s3.cr51 & 0x0c;
675 // res |= ((vga.crtc.offset & 0x0300) >> 4);
676 res |= (s3.cr51 & 0x30);
677 return res;
678 }),
679 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
680 s3.cr51 = data;
681 vga.crtc.start_addr_latch &= ~0xc0000;
682 vga.crtc.start_addr_latch |= ((data & 0x3) << 18);
683 svga.bank_w = (svga.bank_w & 0xcf) | ((data & 0x0c) << 2);
684 svga.bank_r = svga.bank_w;
685 refresh_pitch_offset();
686 s3_define_video_mode();
687 })
688 );
689 // Extended BIOS flag 1 register (EXT_BBFLG1) (CR52)
690 map(0x52, 0x52).lrw8(
691 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
692 return s3.cr52;
693 }),
694 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
695 s3.cr52 = data;
696 })
697 );
698 map(0x53, 0x53).lrw8(
699 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
700 return s3.cr53;
701 }),
702 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
703 s3.cr53 = data;
704 })
705 );
706 // Extended Memory Control 2 Register (EX_MCTL_2) (CR54)
707 map(0x54, 0x54).lrw8(
708 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
709 return s3.cr54;
710 }),
711 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
712 s3.cr54 = data;
713 })
714 );
715 /*
716 CR55 Extended Video DAC Control Register (80x +)
717 bit 0-1 DAC Register Select Bits. Passed to the RS2 and RS3 pins on the
718 RAMDAC, allowing access to all 8 or 16 registers on advanced RAMDACs.
719 If this field is 0, 3d4h index 43h bit 1 is active.
720 2 Enable General Input Port Read. If set DAC reads are disabled and the
721 STRD strobe for reading the General Input Port is enabled for reading
722 while DACRD is active, if clear DAC reads are enabled.
723 3 (928) Enable External SID Operation if set. If set video data is
724 passed directly from the VRAMs to the DAC rather than through the
725 VGA chip
726 4 Hardware Cursor MS/X11 Mode. If set the Hardware Cursor is in X11
727 mode, if clear in MS-Windows mode
728 5 (80x,928) Hardware Cursor External Operation Mode. If set the two
729 bits of cursor data ,is output on the HC[0-1] pins for the video DAC
730 The SENS pin becomes HC1 and the MID2 pin becomes HC0.
731 6 ??
732 7 (80x,928) Disable PA Output. If set PA[0-7] and VCLK are tristated.
733 (864/964) TOFF VCLK. Tri-State Off VCLK Output. VCLK output tri
734 -stated if set
735 */
736 map(0x55, 0x55).lrw8(
737 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
738 return s3.extended_dac_ctrl;
739 }),
740 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
741 s3.extended_dac_ctrl = data;
742 })
743 );
744 // External Sync Control 1 Register (EX_SYNC_1) (CR56)
745 map(0x56, 0x56).lrw8(
746 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
747 return s3.cr56;
748 }),
749 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
750 s3.cr56 = data & 0x1F; // bits 7-5 reserved
751 })
752 );
753 // External Sync Control 2 Register (EX_SYNC_2) (CR57)
754 map(0x57, 0x57).lrw8(
755 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
756 return s3.cr57;
757 }),
758 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
759 s3.cr57 = data;
760 })
761 );
762 // Linear Address Window Control Register (LAW_CTL) (CR58) - dosbox calls VGA_StartUpdateLFB() after storing the value
763 map(0x58, 0x58).lrw8(
764 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
765 return s3.cr58;
766 }),
767 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
768 s3.cr58 = data;
769 on_crtc_linear_regs_changed();
770 redraw_area(0, 0, old_iWidth, old_iHeight);
771 })
772 );
773 // Linear Address Window Position High
774 map(0x59, 0x59).lrw8(
775 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
776 return s3.cr59;
777 }),
778 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
779 s3.cr59 = data;
780 update_pci_bar0_from_crtc(u32(data) << 24, 0xff000000U);
781 on_crtc_linear_regs_changed();
782 })
783 );
784 // Linear Address Window Position Low
785 map(0x5a, 0x5a).lrw8(
786 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
787 return s3.cr5a;
788 }),
789 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
790 s3.cr5a = data;
791 update_pci_bar0_from_crtc(u32(data) << 16, 0x00800000U);
792 on_crtc_linear_regs_changed();
793 })
794 );
795 // undocumented on trio64?
796 map(0x5b, 0x5b).lrw8(
797 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
798 return s3.cr5b;
799 }),
800 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
801 s3.cr5b = data;
802 })
803 );
804 // TODO: bits 7-4 (w/o?) for GPIO
805 map(0x5c, 0x5c).lr8(
806 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
807 u8 res = 0;
808 // if VGA dot clock is set to 3 (misc reg bits 2-3), then selected dot clock is read, otherwise read VGA clock select
809 if ((vga.miscellaneous_output & 0xc) == 0x0c)
810 res = s3.cr42 & 0x0f;
811 else
812 res = (vga.miscellaneous_output & 0xc) >> 2;
813 return res;
814 })
815 );
816 // TODO: following two registers must be read-backable
817 /*
818 CR5D Extended Horizontal Overflow Register (80x +)
819 bit 0 Horizontal Total bit 8. Bit 8 of the Horizontal Total register (3d4h
820 index 0)
821 1 Horizontal Display End bit 8. Bit 8 of the Horizontal Display End
822 register (3d4h index 1)
823 2 Start Horizontal Blank bit 8. Bit 8 of the Horizontal Start Blanking
824 register (3d4h index 2).
825 3 (864,964) EHB+64. End Horizontal Blank +64. If set the /BLANK pulse
826 is extended by 64 DCLKs. Note: Is this bit 6 of 3d4h index 3 or
827 does it really extend by 64 ?
828 4 Start Horizontal Sync Position bit 8. Bit 8 of the Horizontal Start
829 Retrace register (3d4h index 4).
830 5 (864,964) EHS+32. End Horizontal Sync +32. If set the HSYNC pulse
831 is extended by 32 DCLKs. Note: Is this bit 5 of 3d4h index 5 or
832 does it really extend by 32 ?
833 6 (928,964) Data Transfer Position bit 8. Bit 8 of the Data Transfer
834 Position register (3d4h index 3Bh)
835 7 (928,964) Bus-Grant Terminate Position bit 8. Bit 8 of the Bus Grant
836 Termination register (3d4h index 5Fh).
837 */
838 map(0x5d, 0x5d).lrw8(
839 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
840 // Recompose CR5D from the extended CRTC fields
841 u8 res = 0;
842 res |= (vga.crtc.horz_total >> 8) & 0x01; // bit 0
843 res |= ((vga.crtc.horz_disp_end >> 7) & 0x02); // bit 1
844 res |= s3.cr5d & 0x04; // bit 2
845 // bit 3: EHB+64 extension — stored in s3.cr5d
846 res |= (s3.cr5d & 0x08);
847 res |= s3.cr5d & 0x10; // bit 4
848 // bit 5: EHS+32 extension — stored in s3.cr5d
849 res |= (s3.cr5d & 0x20);
850 // bits 6-7: DTP bit8, BGT bit8 — stored in s3.cr5d
851 res |= (s3.cr5d & 0xC0);
852 return res;
853 }),
854 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
855 s3.cr5d = data; // ES40: cache for readback of non-decomposed bits
856 vga.crtc.horz_total = (vga.crtc.horz_total & 0xfeff) | ((data & 0x01) << 8);
857 vga.crtc.horz_disp_end = (vga.crtc.horz_disp_end & 0xfeff) | ((data & 0x02) << 7);
858 vga.crtc.horz_blank_start = (vga.crtc.horz_blank_start & 0xfeff) | ((data & 0x04) << 6);
859 vga.crtc.horz_blank_end = (vga.crtc.horz_blank_end & 0xffbf) | ((data & 0x08) << 3);
860 vga.crtc.horz_retrace_start = (vga.crtc.horz_retrace_start & 0xfeff) | ((data & 0x10) << 4);
861 vga.crtc.horz_retrace_end = (vga.crtc.horz_retrace_end & 0xffdf) | (data & 0x20);
862 s3_define_video_mode();
863 // ES40 extension: recompute derived layout
864 recompute_scanline_layout();
865 })
866 );
867
868 /*
869 CR5E: Extended Vertical Overflow Register (80x +)
870 bit 0 Vertical Total bit 10. Bit 10 of the Vertical Total register (3d4h
871 index 6). Bits 8 and 9 are in 3d4h index 7 bit 0 and 5.
872 1 Vertical Display End bit 10. Bit 10 of the Vertical Display End
873 register (3d4h index 12h). Bits 8 and 9 are in 3d4h index 7 bit 1
874 and 6
875 2 Start Vertical Blank bit 10. Bit 10 of the Vertical Start Blanking
876 register (3d4h index 15h). Bit 8 is in 3d4h index 7 bit 3 and bit 9
877 in 3d4h index 9 bit 5
878 4 Vertical Retrace Start bit 10. Bit 10 of the Vertical Start Retrace
879 register (3d4h index 10h). Bits 8 and 9 are in 3d4h index 7 bit 2
880 and 7.
881 6 Line Compare Position bit 10. Bit 10 of the Line Compare register
882 (3d4h index 18h). Bit 8 is in 3d4h index 7 bit 4 and bit 9 in 3d4h
883 index 9 bit 6.
884 */
885 map(0x5e, 0x5e).lrw8(
886 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
887 // Recompose CR5E from the extended CRTC fields
888 u8 res = 0;
889 res |= (vga.crtc.vert_total >> 10) & 0x01; // bit 0
890 res |= ((vga.crtc.vert_disp_end >> 9) & 0x02); // bit 1
891 res |= ((vga.crtc.vert_blank_start >> 8) & 0x04); // bit 2
892 // bit 3: reserved
893 res |= ((vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start >> 6) & 0x10); // bit 4
894 // bit 5: reserved
895 res |= ((vga.crtc.line_compare >> 4) & 0x40); // bit 6
896 // bit 7: reserved
897 return res;
898 }),
899 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
900 vga.crtc.vert_total = (vga.crtc.vert_total & 0xfbff) | ((data & 0x01) << 10);
901 vga.crtc.vert_disp_end = (vga.crtc.vert_disp_end & 0xfbff) | ((data & 0x02) << 9);
902 vga.crtc.vert_blank_start = (vga.crtc.vert_blank_start & 0xfbff) | ((data & 0x04) << 8);
903 vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start = (vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start & 0xfbff) | ((data & 0x10) << 6);
904 vga.crtc.line_compare = (vga.crtc.line_compare & 0xfbff) | ((data & 0x40) << 4);
905 s3_define_video_mode();
906 })
907 );
908 map(0x5f, 0x5f).lrw8(
909 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
910 return s3.cr5f;
911 }),
912 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
913 s3.cr5f = data;
914 })
915 );
916 // Extended Memory Control 3 Register (EXT-MCTL-3) (CR60)
917 map(0x60, 0x60).lrw8(
918 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
919 return s3.cr60;
920 }),
921 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
922 s3.cr60 = data;
923 })
924 );
925 // Extended Memory Control 4 Register (EXT-MCTL-4) (CR61)
926 map(0x61, 0x61).lrw8(
927 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
928 return s3.cr61;
929 }),
930 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
931 s3.cr61 = data;
932 })
933 );
934 // undocumented?
935 map(0x62, 0x62).lrw8(
936 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
937 return s3.cr62;
938 }),
939 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
940 s3.cr62 = data;
941 })
942 );
943 // External Sync Control 3 Register (EX-SYNC-3) (CR63)
944 map(0x63, 0x63).lrw8(
945 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
946 return s3.cr63;
947 }),
948 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
949 s3.cr63 = data;
950 })
951 );
952 // undocumented?
953 map(0x64, 0x64).lrw8(
954 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
955 return s3.cr64;
956 }),
957 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
958 s3.cr64 = data;
959 })
960 );
961 // Extended Miscellaneous Control Register (EXT-MISC-CTL) (CR6S)
962 map(0x65, 0x65).lrw8(
963 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
964 return s3.cr65;
965 }),
966 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
967 s3.cr65 = data;
968 })
969 );
970 // Extended Miscellaneous Control 1 Register (EXT-MISC-1) (CR66) - S3 BIOS writes 0 here - normal operation & PCI bus disconnect disabled
971 map(0x66, 0x66).lrw8(
972 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
973 return s3.cr66;
974 }),
975 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
976 s3.cr66 = data;
977 if (data & 0x02) {
978 accel_reset();
979 }
980 })
981 );
982 map(0x67, 0x67).lrw8(
983 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
984 return s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2;
985 }),
986 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
987 s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2 = data;
988 s3_define_video_mode();
989 })
990 );
991 map(0x68, 0x68).lrw8(
992 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { // Configuration register 3
993 // no /CAS,/OE stretch time, 32-bit data bus size
994 return (s3.strapping & 0x00ff0000) >> 16;
995 }),
996 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
997 if (s3.reg_lock2 == 0xa5)
998 {
999 s3.strapping = (s3.strapping & 0xff00ffff) | (data << 16);
1000 LOG("%s: CR68: Strapping data = %08x\n", devid_string, s3.strapping);
1001 }
1002 })
1003 );
1004 map(0x69, 0x69).lrw8(
1005 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1006 return vga.crtc.start_addr_latch >> 16;
1007 }),
1008 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1009 vga.crtc.start_addr_latch &= ~0x1f0000;
1010 vga.crtc.start_addr_latch |= ((data & 0x1f) << 16);
1011 s3_define_video_mode();
1012 })
1013 );
1014 map(0x6a, 0x6a).lrw8(
1015 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1016 return vga.crtc.data[0x6a] & 0x3f;
1017 }),
1018 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1019 vga.crtc.data[0x6a] = data;
1020 svga.bank_w = data & 0x3f;
1021 svga.bank_r = svga.bank_w;
1022 })
1023 );
1024 // Extended BIOS Flag 3 (CR6B), R/W BIOS scratchpad (DB014-B 17-14).
1025 // Trio64's BAR0 address aliases are CR59/CR5A; CR53[3] is reserved.
1026 map(0x6b, 0x6b).lrw8(
1027 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1028 return s3.cr6b;
1029 }),
1030 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1031 s3.cr6b = data;
1032 })
1033 );
1034 // Extended BIOS Flag 4 Register (EBIOS-FLG3) (CR6C) - Bios scratchpad
1035 map(0x6c, 0x6c).lrw8(
1036 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1037 return s3.cr6c;
1038 }),
1039 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1040 s3.cr6c = data;
1041 })
1042 );
1043 // undocumented
1044 map(0x6d, 0x6d).lrw8(
1045 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1046 return s3.cr6d;
1047 }),
1048 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1049 s3.cr6d = data;
1050 })
1051 );
1052 // Configuration register 4 (Trio64V+)
1053 map(0x6f, 0x6f).lrw8(
1054 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1055 // LPB(?) mode, Serial port I/O at port 0xe8, Serial port I/O disabled (MMIO only), no WE delay
1056 return (s3.strapping & 0xff000000) >> 24;
1057 }),
1058 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1059 if (s3.reg_lock2 == 0xa5)
1060 {
1061 s3.strapping = (s3.strapping & 0x00ffffff) | (data << 24);
1062 LOG("%s: CR6F: Strapping data = %08x\n", devid_string, s3.strapping);
1063 }
1064 })
1065 );
1066}
1067
1068void CS3Trio64::sequencer_map(address_map& map)
1069{
1070 svga_device::sequencer_map(map);
1071 // map(0x00, 0x00) Reset Register
1072 map(0x00, 0x00).lw8( // es40 deviation
1073 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1074 if (seq_reset1() && ((data & 0x01) == 0))
1075 {
1076 vga.sequencer.data[3] = 0;
1077 vga.sequencer.char_sel.A = 0;
1078 vga.sequencer.char_sel.B = 0;
1079 vga.sequencer.char_sel.base[0] = 0x20000;
1080 vga.sequencer.char_sel.base[1] = 0x20000;
1081 m_output.display().lock();
1082 m_output.display().set_text_charmap(&vga.memory[0x20000]);
1083 m_output.display().unlock();
1084 state.vga_mem_updated = 1;
1085 }
1086 vga.sequencer.data[0] = data;
1087 })
1088 );
1089 // map(0x01, 0x01) Clocking Mode Register
1090 // SR01: Clocking Mode Register
1091 map(0x01, 0x01).lw8( // es40 deviation
1092 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1093 u8 newreg1 = data & 0x3f;
1094 if (m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x34) & 0x20) {
1095 newreg1 = (newreg1 & ~0x01) | (vga.sequencer.data[1] & 0x01);
1096 }
1097 vga.sequencer.data[1] = newreg1;
1098 })
1099 );
1100
1101 // Sequencer Memory Mode Register
1102// map(0x04, 0x04)
1103 map(0x04, 0x04).lw8(
1104 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1105 vga.sequencer.data[4] = data;
1106 })
1107 );
1108
1109 // (undocumented) Sequencer Horizontal Character Counter Reset
1110 // Any write strobe to this register will lock the character generator until another write to other regs happens.
1111 // map(0x07, 0x07)
1112 // TODO: SR8 (unlocks SRD)
1113 // SR08: PLL Unlock
1114 map(0x08, 0x08).lrw8(
1115 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return vga.sequencer.data[0x08]; }),
1116 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1117 vga.sequencer.data[0x08] = data;
1118 })
1119 );
1120 // SR09: Extended (reserved)
1121 map(0x09, 0x09).lrw8(
1122 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return vga.sequencer.data[0x09]; }),
1123 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1124 vga.sequencer.data[0x09] = data;
1125 })
1126 );
1127 // SR0A
1128 map(0x0a, 0x0a).lrw8(
1129 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return vga.sequencer.data[0x0a]; }),
1130 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1131 vga.sequencer.data[0x0a] = data;
1132 })
1133 );
1134 // SR0B
1135 map(0x0b, 0x0b).lrw8(
1136 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return vga.sequencer.data[0x0b]; }),
1137 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1138 vga.sequencer.data[0x0b] = data;
1139 })
1140 );
1141 // SR0D
1142 map(0x0d, 0x0d).lrw8(
1143 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return vga.sequencer.data[0x0d]; }),
1144 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1145 vga.sequencer.data[0x0d] = data;
1146 })
1147 );
1148 // Memory CLK PLL
1149 map(0x10, 0x10).lrw8(
1150 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return s3.sr10; }),
1151 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) { s3.sr10 = data; })
1152 );
1153 map(0x11, 0x11).lrw8(
1154 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return s3.sr11; }),
1155 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) { s3.sr11 = data; })
1156 );
1157 // Video CLK PLL
1158 map(0x12, 0x12).lrw8(
1159 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return s3.sr12; }),
1160 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) { s3.sr12 = data; load_dclk(); })
1161 );
1162 map(0x13, 0x13).lrw8(
1163 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return s3.sr13; }),
1164 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) { s3.sr13 = data; load_dclk(); })
1165 );
1166 // SR14: CLKSYN Control 1
1167 map(0x14, 0x14).lrw8(
1168 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return vga.sequencer.data[0x14]; }),
1169 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1170 vga.sequencer.data[0x14] = data;
1171 })
1172 );
1173 map(0x15, 0x15).lrw8(
1174 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return s3.sr15; }),
1175 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1176 s3.sr15 = data;
1177 load_dclk();
1178 })
1179 );
1180 map(0x17, 0x17).lr8(
1181 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
1182 // CLKSYN test register
1183 const u8 res = s3.sr17;
1184 // who knows what it should return, docs only say it defaults to 0, and is reserved for testing of the clock synthesiser
1185 if (!machine().side_effects_disabled())
1186 s3.sr17--;
1187 return res;
1188 })
1189 );
1190 // SR18: RAMDAC/CLKSYN Control
1191 map(0x18, 0x18).lrw8(
1192 NAME([this](offs_t offset) { return s3.sr18; }),
1193 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
1194 s3.sr18 = data;
1195 vga.sequencer.data[0x18] = data;
1196 })
1197 );
1198}
1199
1200uint8_t CS3Trio64::mem_r(uint32_t offset)
1201{
1202 // Standard MMIO (DB014-B 13.3.1): enhanced registers read at A8000h + their I/O address.
1203 // The packed 81xxh aliases are write-only and read back through AccelIORead's default.
1204 if ((s3.cr53 & 0x10) && offset >= 0x8000 && offset < 0x10000)
1205 return AccelIORead(offset);
1206
1207 if (svga.rgb8_en || svga.rgb15_en || svga.rgb16_en || svga.rgb32_en)
1208 {
1209 int data;
1210 if (offset & 0x10000)
1211 return 0;
1212 data = 0;
1213 if (vga.sequencer.data[4] & 0x8)
1214 {
1215 // DB014-B 15-2/17-13: enhanced CPU access shares the bank controls.
1216 const u8 bank = uses_sized_linear_bar_window() ?
1217 ((s3.memory_config & 0x01) ? cpu_bank() : 0) : svga.bank_r;
1218 if ((offset + (bank * 0x10000)) < vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
1219 data = vga.memory[(offset + (bank * 0x10000))];
1220 }
1221 else
1222 {
1223 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
1224 {
1225 if (vga.sequencer.map_mask & 1 << i)
1226 {
1227 if ((offset * 4 + i + (svga.bank_r * 0x10000)) < vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
1228 data |= vga.memory[(offset * 4 + i + (svga.bank_r * 0x10000))];
1229 }
1230 }
1231 }
1232 return (uint8_t)data;
1233 }
1234
1235 // Standard VGA fallback — full read-mode/latch pipeline via base class
1236 if ((offset + (svga.bank_r * 0x10000)) < vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
1237 return vga_device::mem_r(offset);
1238 return 0xff;
1239}
1240
1241void CS3Trio64::mem_w(offs_t offset, uint8_t data)
1242{
1243 ibm8514a_device* dev = get_8514();
1244 // bit 4 of CR53 enables memory-mapped I/O
1245 // 0xA0000-0xA7fff maps to port 0xE2E8 (pixel transfer)
1246 if (s3.cr53 & 0x10)
1247 {
1248 if (offset < 0x8000) {
1249 // Lower half of the MMIO window is PIX_TRANS FIFO.
1250 // Feed it through the same bus-size aware path as port I/O.
1251 AccelIOWrite(0xE2E8 + (offset & 3), data);
1252 return;
1253 }
1254
1255#ifdef DEBUG_VGA_MEMW
1256 printf("%s: Memory write offset=%05x data=%02x\n", devid_string, (unsigned)offset, (unsigned)data);
1257#endif
1258
1259 switch (offset)
1260 {
1261 case 0x8100:
1262 case 0x82e8:
1263 dev->ibm8514.curr_y = (dev->ibm8514.curr_y & 0xff00) | data;
1264 dev->ibm8514.prev_y = (dev->ibm8514.prev_y & 0xff00) | data;
1265 break;
1266 case 0x8101:
1267 case 0x82e9:
1268 dev->ibm8514.curr_y = (dev->ibm8514.curr_y & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1269 dev->ibm8514.prev_y = (dev->ibm8514.prev_y & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1270 break;
1271 case 0x8102:
1272 case 0x86e8:
1273 dev->ibm8514.curr_x = (dev->ibm8514.curr_x & 0xff00) | data;
1274 dev->ibm8514.prev_x = (dev->ibm8514.prev_x & 0xff00) | data;
1275 break;
1276 case 0x8103:
1277 case 0x86e9:
1278 dev->ibm8514.curr_x = (dev->ibm8514.curr_x & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1279 dev->ibm8514.prev_x = (dev->ibm8514.prev_x & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1280 break;
1281 case 0x8108:
1282 case 0x8ae8:
1283 dev->ibm8514.line_axial_step = (dev->ibm8514.line_axial_step & 0xff00) | data;
1284 dev->ibm8514.dest_y = (dev->ibm8514.dest_y & 0xff00) | data;
1285 break;
1286 case 0x8109:
1287 case 0x8ae9:
1288 dev->ibm8514.line_axial_step = (dev->ibm8514.line_axial_step & 0x00ff) | ((data & 0x3f) << 8);
1289 dev->ibm8514.dest_y = (dev->ibm8514.dest_y & 0x00ff) | ((data & 0x0f) << 8);
1290 break;
1291 case 0x810a:
1292 case 0x8ee8:
1293 dev->ibm8514.line_diagonal_step = (dev->ibm8514.line_diagonal_step & 0xff00) | data;
1294 dev->ibm8514.dest_x = (dev->ibm8514.dest_x & 0xff00) | data;
1295 break;
1296 case 0x810b:
1297 case 0x8ee9:
1298 dev->ibm8514.line_diagonal_step = (dev->ibm8514.line_diagonal_step & 0x00ff) | ((data & 0x3f) << 8);
1299 dev->ibm8514.dest_x = (dev->ibm8514.dest_x & 0x00ff) | ((data & 0x0f) << 8);
1300 break;
1301 case 0x8118:
1302 case 0x9ae8:
1303 s3.mmio_9ae8 = (s3.mmio_9ae8 & 0xff00) | data;
1304 break;
1305 case 0x8119:
1306 case 0x9ae9:
1307 s3.mmio_9ae8 = (s3.mmio_9ae8 & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1308 dev->ibm8514_cmd_w(s3.mmio_9ae8);
1309 break;
1310 case 0x8120:
1311 case 0xa2e8:
1312 dev->ibm8514.bgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.bgcolour & 0xffffff00) | data;
1313 break;
1314 case 0x8121:
1315 case 0xa2e9:
1316 dev->ibm8514.bgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.bgcolour & 0xffff00ff) | (data << 8);
1317 break;
1318 case 0x8122:
1319 case 0xa2ea:
1320 dev->ibm8514.bgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.bgcolour & 0xff00ffff) | (data << 16);
1321 break;
1322 case 0x8123:
1323 case 0xa2eb:
1324 dev->ibm8514.bgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.bgcolour & 0x00ffffff) | (data << 24);
1325 break;
1326 case 0x8124:
1327 case 0xa6e8:
1328 dev->ibm8514.fgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.fgcolour & 0xffffff00) | data;
1329 break;
1330 case 0x8125:
1331 case 0xa6e9:
1332 dev->ibm8514.fgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.fgcolour & 0xffff00ff) | (data << 8);
1333 break;
1334 case 0x8126:
1335 case 0xa6ea:
1336 dev->ibm8514.fgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.fgcolour & 0xff00ffff) | (data << 16);
1337 break;
1338 case 0x8127:
1339 case 0xa6eb:
1340 dev->ibm8514.fgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.fgcolour & 0x00ffffff) | (data << 24);
1341 break;
1342 case 0x8128:
1343 case 0xaae8:
1344 dev->ibm8514.write_mask = (dev->ibm8514.write_mask & 0xffffff00) | data;
1345 break;
1346 case 0x8129:
1347 case 0xaae9:
1348 dev->ibm8514.write_mask = (dev->ibm8514.write_mask & 0xffff00ff) | (data << 8);
1349 break;
1350 case 0x812a:
1351 case 0xaaea:
1352 dev->ibm8514.write_mask = (dev->ibm8514.write_mask & 0xff00ffff) | (data << 16);
1353 break;
1354 case 0x812b:
1355 case 0xaaeb:
1356 dev->ibm8514.write_mask = (dev->ibm8514.write_mask & 0x00ffffff) | (data << 24);
1357 break;
1358 case 0x812c:
1359 case 0xaee8:
1360 dev->ibm8514.read_mask = (dev->ibm8514.read_mask & 0xffffff00) | data;
1361 break;
1362 case 0x812d:
1363 case 0xaee9:
1364 dev->ibm8514.read_mask = (dev->ibm8514.read_mask & 0xffff00ff) | (data << 8);
1365 break;
1366 case 0x812e:
1367 case 0xaeea:
1368 dev->ibm8514.read_mask = (dev->ibm8514.read_mask & 0xff00ffff) | (data << 16);
1369 break;
1370 case 0x812f:
1371 case 0xaeeb:
1372 dev->ibm8514.read_mask = (dev->ibm8514.read_mask & 0x00ffffff) | (data << 24);
1373 break;
1374 case 0x8130:
1375 case 0xb2e8:
1376 dev->ibm8514.color_cmp = (dev->ibm8514.color_cmp & 0xffffff00) | data;
1377 break;
1378 case 0x8131:
1379 case 0xb2e9:
1380 dev->ibm8514.color_cmp = (dev->ibm8514.color_cmp & 0xffff00ff) | (data << 8);
1381 break;
1382 case 0x8132:
1383 case 0xb2ea:
1384 dev->ibm8514.color_cmp = (dev->ibm8514.color_cmp & 0xff00ffff) | (data << 16);
1385 break;
1386 case 0x8133:
1387 case 0xb2eb:
1388 dev->ibm8514.color_cmp = (dev->ibm8514.color_cmp & 0x00ffffff) | (data << 24);
1389 break;
1390 case 0xb6e8:
1391 case 0x8134:
1392 dev->ibm8514.bgmix = (dev->ibm8514.bgmix & 0xff00) | data;
1393 break;
1394 case 0x8135:
1395 case 0xb6e9:
1396 dev->ibm8514.bgmix = (dev->ibm8514.bgmix & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1397 dev->ibm8514.bkgd_sel = (dev->ibm8514.bgmix >> 5) & 3;
1398 dev->ibm8514.bkgd_mix_mode = dev->ibm8514.bgmix & 0x0f;
1399 break;
1400 case 0x8136:
1401 case 0xbae8:
1402 dev->ibm8514.fgmix = (dev->ibm8514.fgmix & 0xff00) | data;
1403 break;
1404 case 0x8137:
1405 case 0xbae9:
1406 dev->ibm8514.fgmix = (dev->ibm8514.fgmix & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1407 dev->ibm8514.frgd_sel = (dev->ibm8514.fgmix >> 5) & 3;
1408 dev->ibm8514.frgd_mix_mode = dev->ibm8514.fgmix & 0x0f;
1409 break;
1410 case 0x8138:
1411 dev->ibm8514.scissors_top = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_top & 0xff00) | data;
1412 break;
1413 case 0x8139:
1414 dev->ibm8514.scissors_top = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_top & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1415 break;
1416 case 0x813a:
1417 dev->ibm8514.scissors_left = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_left & 0xff00) | data;
1418 break;
1419 case 0x813b:
1420 dev->ibm8514.scissors_left = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_left & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1421 break;
1422 case 0x813c:
1423 dev->ibm8514.scissors_bottom = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_bottom & 0xff00) | data;
1424 break;
1425 case 0x813d:
1426 dev->ibm8514.scissors_bottom = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_bottom & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1427 break;
1428 case 0x813e:
1429 dev->ibm8514.scissors_right = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_right & 0xff00) | data;
1430 break;
1431 case 0x813f:
1432 dev->ibm8514.scissors_right = (dev->ibm8514.scissors_right & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1433 break;
1434 case 0x8140:
1435 dev->ibm8514.pixel_control = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_control & 0xff00) | data;
1436 break;
1437 case 0x8141:
1438 dev->ibm8514.pixel_control = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_control & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1439 break;
1440 case 0x8146:
1441 dev->ibm8514.multifunc_sel = (dev->ibm8514.multifunc_sel & 0xff00) | data;
1442 break;
1443 case 0x8148:
1444 dev->ibm8514.rect_height = (dev->ibm8514.rect_height & 0xff00) | data;
1445 break;
1446 case 0x8149:
1447 dev->ibm8514.rect_height = (dev->ibm8514.rect_height & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1448 break;
1449 case 0x814a:
1450 dev->ibm8514.rect_width = (dev->ibm8514.rect_width & 0xff00) | data;
1451 break;
1452 case 0x814b:
1453 dev->ibm8514.rect_width = (dev->ibm8514.rect_width & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1454 break;
1455 case 0x8150: case 0x8151: case 0x8152: case 0x8153:
1456 // MMIO mirror of PIX_TRANS inside the upper half window.
1457 AccelIOWrite(0xE2E8 + (offset - 0x8150), data);
1458 break;
1459 case 0xbee8:
1460 s3.mmio_bee8 = (s3.mmio_bee8 & 0xff00) | data;
1461 break;
1462 case 0xbee9:
1463 s3.mmio_bee8 = (s3.mmio_bee8 & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1464 dev->ibm8514_multifunc_w(s3.mmio_bee8);
1465 break;
1466 case 0x96e8:
1467 s3.mmio_96e8 = (s3.mmio_96e8 & 0xff00) | data;
1468 break;
1469 case 0x96e9:
1470 s3.mmio_96e8 = (s3.mmio_96e8 & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1471 dev->ibm8514_width_w(s3.mmio_96e8);
1472 break;
1473 case 0x92e8:
1474 s3.mmio_92e8 = (s3.mmio_92e8 & 0xff00) | data;
1475 break;
1476 case 0x92e9:
1477 s3.mmio_92e8 = (s3.mmio_92e8 & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
1478 dev->ibm8514_line_error_w(s3.mmio_92e8);
1479 break;
1480 case 0xe2e8: case 0xe2e9: case 0xe2ea: case 0xe2eb:
1481 // Normal PIX_TRANS MMIO addresses used by the VMS X11 driver
1482 AccelIOWrite(offset, data);
1483 break;
1484 default:
1485 LOG("%s: MMIO offset %05x write %02x\n", devid_string, offset + 0xa0000, data);
1486 break;
1487 }
1488 return;
1489 }
1490
1491 if (svga.rgb8_en || svga.rgb15_en || svga.rgb16_en || svga.rgb32_en)
1492 {
1493 if (offset & 0x10000)
1494 return;
1495 if (vga.sequencer.data[4] & 0x8)
1496 {
1497 const u8 bank = uses_sized_linear_bar_window() ?
1498 ((s3.memory_config & 0x01) ? cpu_bank() : 0) : svga.bank_w;
1499 if ((offset + (bank * 0x10000)) < vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
1500 vga.memory[(offset + (bank * 0x10000))] = data;
1501 }
1502 else
1503 {
1504 int i;
1505 for (i = 0; i < 4; i++)
1506 {
1507 if (vga.sequencer.map_mask & 1 << i)
1508 {
1509 if ((offset * 4 + i + (svga.bank_w * 0x10000)) < vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
1510 vga.memory[(offset * 4 + i + (svga.bank_w * 0x10000))] = data;
1511 }
1512 }
1513 }
1514 return;
1515 }
1516
1517 if ((offset + (svga.bank_w * 0x10000)) < vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
1518 vga_device::mem_w(offset, data);
1519}
1520
1521uint32_t CS3Trio64::screen_update(screen_device& screen, bitmap_rgb32& bitmap, const rectangle& cliprect)
1522{
1523 svga_device::screen_update(screen, bitmap, cliprect);
1524
1525 uint8_t cur_mode = pc_vga_choosevideomode();
1526
1527#ifdef DEBUG_VGA_RENDER
1528 static uint8_t last_mode = 0xff;
1529 if (cur_mode != last_mode) {
1530 LOGCRTC("%s: Screen mode changed to %d (rgb8=%d sync=%d graphic=%d)\n",
1531 devid_string, cur_mode, svga.rgb8_en, vga.crtc.sync_en, vga.gc.alpha_dis);
1532 LOGCRTC("%s: Visible area=(%d,%d)-(%d,%d) bitmap=%dx%d\n",
1533 devid_string, cliprect.min_x, cliprect.min_y, cliprect.max_x, cliprect.max_y,
1534 bitmap.width(), bitmap.height());
1535 LOGCRTC("%s: CRTC offset=%03x seq4=%02x chain4=%d height=%d lines=%d columns=%d\n",
1536 devid_string, vga.crtc.offset, vga.sequencer.data[4],
1537 (vga.sequencer.data[4] & 0x08) ? 1 : 0,
1538 vga.crtc.maximum_scan_line * (vga.crtc.scan_doubling + 1),
1539 (vga.crtc.vert_disp_end + 1), (vga.crtc.horz_disp_end + 1));
1540 last_mode = cur_mode;
1541 }
1542#endif
1543
1544 // draw hardware graphics cursor
1545 // TODO: support 16 bit and greater video modes
1546 // TODO: should be a derived function from svga_device
1547 if (s3.cursor_mode & 0x01) // if cursor is enabled
1548 {
1549 uint16_t cx = s3.cursor_x & 0x07ff;
1550 uint16_t cy = s3.cursor_y & 0x07ff;
1551
1552 if (cur_mode == SCREEN_OFF || cur_mode == TEXT_MODE || cur_mode == MONO_MODE || cur_mode == CGA_MODE || cur_mode == EGA_MODE)
1553 return 0; // cursor only works in VGA or SVGA modes
1554
1555 uint32_t src = s3.cursor_start_addr * 1024; // start address is in units of 1024 bytes
1556
1557 uint32_t bg_col;
1558 uint32_t fg_col;
1559 int r, g, b;
1560 uint32_t datax;
1561 switch (cur_mode)
1562 {
1563 case RGB15_MODE:
1564 case RGB16_MODE:
1565 datax = s3.cursor_bg[0] | s3.cursor_bg[1] << 8;
1566 r = (datax & 0xf800) >> 11;
1567 g = (datax & 0x07e0) >> 5;
1568 b = (datax & 0x001f) >> 0;
1569 r = (r << 3) | (r & 0x7);
1570 g = (g << 2) | (g & 0x3);
1571 b = (b << 3) | (b & 0x7);
1572 bg_col = (0xff << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | (b << 0);
1573
1574 datax = s3.cursor_fg[0] | s3.cursor_fg[1] << 8;
1575 r = (datax & 0xf800) >> 11;
1576 g = (datax & 0x07e0) >> 5;
1577 b = (datax & 0x001f) >> 0;
1578 r = (r << 3) | (r & 0x7);
1579 g = (g << 2) | (g & 0x3);
1580 b = (b << 3) | (b & 0x7);
1581 fg_col = (0xff << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | (b << 0);
1582 break;
1583 case RGB24_MODE:
1584 case RGB32_MODE:
1585 datax = s3.cursor_bg[0] | s3.cursor_bg[1] << 8 | s3.cursor_bg[2] << 16;
1586 r = (datax & 0xff0000) >> 16;
1587 g = (datax & 0x00ff00) >> 8;
1588 b = (datax & 0x0000ff) >> 0;
1589 bg_col = (0xff << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | (b << 0);
1590
1591 datax = s3.cursor_fg[0] | s3.cursor_fg[1] << 8 | s3.cursor_fg[2] << 16;
1592 r = (datax & 0xff0000) >> 16;
1593 g = (datax & 0x00ff00) >> 8;
1594 b = (datax & 0x0000ff) >> 0;
1595 fg_col = (0xff << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | (b << 0);
1596 break;
1597 case RGB8_MODE:
1598 default:
1599 bg_col = pen(s3.cursor_bg[0]);
1600 fg_col = pen(s3.cursor_fg[0]);
1601 break;
1602 }
1603
1604 for (int y = 0; y < 64; y++)
1605 {
1606 if (cy + y < cliprect.max_y && cx < cliprect.max_x)
1607 {
1608 uint32_t* const dst = &bitmap.pix(cy + y, cx);
1609 for (int x = 0; x < 64; x++)
1610 {
1611 uint16_t bita = (vga.memory[(src + 1) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size]
1612 | ((vga.memory[(src + 0) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size]) << 8))
1613 >> (15 - (x % 16));
1614 uint16_t bitb = (vga.memory[(src + 3) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size]
1615 | ((vga.memory[(src + 2) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size]) << 8))
1616 >> (15 - (x % 16));
1617 uint8_t val = ((bita & 0x01) << 1) | (bitb & 0x01);
1618
1619 if (s3.extended_dac_ctrl & 0x10)
1620 { // X11 mode
1621 switch (val)
1622 {
1623 case 0x00: break; // no change
1624 case 0x01: break; // no change
1625 case 0x02: dst[x] = bg_col; break;
1626 case 0x03: dst[x] = fg_col; break;
1627 }
1628 }
1629 else
1630 { // Windows mode
1631 switch (val)
1632 {
1633 case 0x00: dst[x] = bg_col; break;
1634 case 0x01: dst[x] = fg_col; break;
1635 case 0x02: break; // screen data
1636 case 0x03: dst[x] = ~(dst[x]); break; // inverted
1637 }
1638 }
1639 if (x % 16 == 15)
1640 src += 4;
1641 }
1642 }
1643 }
1644 }
1645 return 0;
1646}

1662// ES40 specific functions
1663
1664// Returns (A<<1)|B for pixel (sx,sy) from a 6464 cursor map.
1665// Supports:
1666// Standard layout (16 bytes/row): A[15:0] then B[15:0] per 16 px (all non-16bpp modes)
1667// 64k layout (16bpp): A byte then B byte per 8 px, each bit horizontally doubled.
1668// Right-storage addressing when CR45 bit4 is set - via MAME
1669static inline u8 s3_cursor_ab(const u8* vram, u32 vram_mask, u32 src_base, unsigned sx, unsigned sy, bool is16bpp, bool right_storage)
1670{
1671 // Compute row base with optional "right storage" skew.
1672 auto row_base_16bytes = [&](unsigned row) -> u32 {
1673 if (!right_storage) {
1674 return src_base + row * 16; // normal: 16 bytes/row
1675 }
1676 // right storage (non-16bpp path): last 256B of each 1KiB line, 4 lines 1KiB
1677 const unsigned lane = (row >> 4) & 0x3; // 0..3
1678 const unsigned r = row & 0x0F; // 0..15 within lane
1679 return src_base + lane * 1024u + (1024u - 256u) + r * 16u;
1680 };
1681
1682 if (!is16bpp) {
1683 // Standard 16B/row path: A[15:0] then B[15:0] per 16 pixels
1684 const unsigned group = sx >> 4; // 0..3
1685 const unsigned bit = 15 - (sx & 15);
1686 const u32 rb = row_base_16bytes(sy);
1687 const u32 src = rb + group * 4u;
1688 const u16 A = (u16)vram[(src + 1) & vram_mask] |
1689 ((u16)vram[(src + 0) & vram_mask] << 8);
1690 const u16 B = (u16)vram[(src + 3) & vram_mask] |
1691 ((u16)vram[(src + 2) & vram_mask] << 8);
1692 return (u8)(((A >> bit) & 1) << 1 | ((B >> bit) & 1));
1693 }
1694 else {
1695 // 64k (16bpp) path: one A byte + one B byte per 8 pixels, bits doubled horizontally.
1696 // We still keep 16 bytes per row total: 8 groups 2 bytes.
1697 // Right storage variant uses last 512B of 22KiB lines.
1698 u32 rb;
1699 if (!right_storage) {
1700 rb = src_base + sy * 16u;
1701 }
1702 else {
1703 const unsigned lane = (sy >> 5) & 0x1; // 0..1
1704 const unsigned r = sy & 0x1F; // 0..31
1705 rb = src_base + lane * 2048u + (2048u - 512u) + r * 16u;
1706 }
1707 const unsigned group8 = sx >> 3; // 0..7 (8px groups)
1708 const u32 src = rb + group8 * 2u; // A byte, then B byte
1709 const u8 Abits = vram[(src + 0) & vram_mask];
1710 const u8 Bbits = vram[(src + 1) & vram_mask];
1711 const unsigned bit = 7 - ((sx & 7) >> 1); // horizontal bit-doubling
1712 const u8 A = (Abits >> bit) & 1;
1713 const u8 B = (Bbits >> bit) & 1;
1714 return (u8)((A << 1) | B);
1715 }
1716}
1717
1728void CS3Trio64::run()
1729{
1730 try
1731 {
1732 // The GUI outlives this worker. Serial-menu save/restore stops and joins the worker.
1733 // Next run must retain the existing window.
1734 if (!m_gui_initialized)
1735 {
1736 // initialize the GUI (and let it know our tilesize)
1737 m_output.display().init(state.x_tilesize, state.y_tilesize);
1738 m_gui_initialized = true;
1739 }
1740 bool was_paused = false;
1741 PauseAck.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
1742 for (;;)
1743 {
1744 // Terminate thread if StopThread is set to true
1745 if (StopThread)
1746 return;
1747 // Handle GUI events (50 times per second)
1748 m_output.display().lock();
1749 m_output.display().handle_events();
1750 m_output.display().unlock();
1751 CThread::sleep(10);
1752
1753 // During firmware reset: keep pumping events (window stays alive),
1754 // but do NOT touch emulated VGA state.
1755 if (PauseThread.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
1756 {
1757 if (!was_paused)
1758 {
1759 m_output.display().lock();
1760 m_output.display().clear_screen(); // optional; comment out if you want last frame to remain
1761 m_output.display().unlock();
1762 was_paused = true;
1763 }
1764 PauseAck.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
1765 continue;
1766 }
1767 PauseAck.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
1768 was_paused = false;
1769
1770 //Update the screen (50 times per second)
1771 m_output.display().lock();
1772 update();
1773 m_output.display().flush();
1774 m_output.display().unlock();
1775 }
1776 }
1777
1778 catch (CException& e)
1779 {
1780 printf("%s: Exception in display thread: %s.\n", devid_string, e.displayText().c_str());
1781
1782 // Let the thread die...
1783 }
1784}
