1838CS3Trio64::CS3Trio64(CConfigurator* cfg, CSystem* c, int pcibus, int pcidev,
1839 bx_gui_c& display) : svga_device(cfg, c, pcibus, pcidev), m_output(0, display)
1840{
1841 // PCI setup consults linear-enable state before the accelerator starts.
1842 m_8514.ibm8514.advfunction_ctrl = 0;
1843 // The first PCI reset precedes init()'s full graphics-state initialization.
1844 s3.cr59 = 0;
1845 s3.cr5a = 0;
1846 m_crtc_space_config = address_space_config("crtc_regs", ENDIANNESS_LITTLE, 8, 8, 0, address_map_constructor(FUNC(CS3Trio64::crtc_map), this));
1847 m_seq_space_config = address_space_config("sequencer_regs", ENDIANNESS_LITTLE, 8, 8, 0, address_map_constructor(FUNC(CS3Trio64::sequencer_map), this));
1848}
1849
1850// --- S3 CR36 -----------------------------------------------------------------
1851// CR36 (Reset State Read 1) encodes DRAM type in the low and the actual VRAM
1852// size in the high.
1853// EDO: <1M=0xFE, 1M=0xDE, 2M=0x9E, 3M=0x5E, 4M=0x1E, 8M=0x7E
1854// Trio64 max display memory is 4 MiB
1855// see DOSBox-X Reset State Read 1
1856// `use_edo` to false for FPM instead of EDO memory
1857static inline uint8_t s3_cr36_from_memsize(uint32_t bytes, bool use_edo /*=true*/) {
1858 const uint8_t type_nibble = use_edo ? 0x0E : 0x0A; // low nibble
1859 uint8_t size_nibble_high;
1860 if (bytes < (1u * 1024 * 1024)) size_nibble_high = 0xF0; // <1MB
1861 else if (bytes < (2u * 1024 * 1024)) size_nibble_high = 0xD0; // 1MB
1862 else if (bytes < (3u * 1024 * 1024)) size_nibble_high = 0x90; // 2MB
1863 else if (bytes < (4u * 1024 * 1024)) size_nibble_high = 0x50; // 3MB
1864 else size_nibble_high = 0x10; // 4MB (or more -> clamp)
1865 return uint8_t(size_nibble_high | type_nibble);
1866}
1867
1868// CR32 (Backward Compatibility 1 - BKWD_1).
1869// Writing 01xx10xx (e.g. 0x48) unlocks S3 VGA regs.
1870static inline bool s3_cr32_is_unlock(uint8_t v) {
1871 return ((v & 0xC0) == 0x40) && ((v & 0x0C) == 0x08);
1872}
1873
1874inline uint32_t CS3Trio64::s3_lfb_base_from_regs() {
1875 // CR59 high, CR5A low, reported as (la_window << 16)
1876 const uint16_t la_window = (uint16_t(m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x59)) << 8) | uint16_t(m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x5A));
1877 return uint32_t(la_window) << 16;
1878}
1879
1880inline uint8_t CS3Trio64::current_char_width_px() const {
1881 // If special blanking (CR33 bit5) is set, S3 forces 8-dot chars.
1882 if (m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x33) & 0x20) return 8;
1883 // Otherwise, use Sequencer reg1 bit0 like the rest of our text logic.
1884 return (vga.sequencer.data[1] & 0x01) ? 8 : 9;
1885}
1886
1887// MMIO alias base offset helper (CR53 bit5: 0=A0000, 1=B8000).
1888inline uint32_t CS3Trio64::s3_mmio_base_off(SS3_state& s) {
1889 // Trio64 CR53 bit5 (A0000/B8000 MMIO base select):
1890 // - 0: A0000...AFFFF is MMIO alias space when CR53 bit4=0
1891 // - 1: B8000..BFFFF is MMIO alias space when CR53 bit4=1
1892 return (s3.cr53 & 0x20) ? 0x18000u : 0u;
1893}
1894
1895// Trio64: "new" MMIO 64 KiB window at LFB + 0x0100_0000 when CR53 bit3 = 1.
1896// We'll at minimum wire the lower 0x8000 to PIXTRANS FIFO (0xE2E8 port semantics).
1897inline bool CS3Trio64::s3_new_mmio_enabled()
1898{
1899 // CR53 - see 86Box behavior gating several "new-mmio" aliases.
1900 return (s3.cr53 & 0x08) != 0;
1901}
1902
1903static inline uint32_t s3_lfb_size_from_cr58(uint8_t cr58) {
1904 switch (cr58 & 0x03) {
1905 case 0: return 64 * 1024;
1906 case 1: return 1u * 1024 * 1024;
1907 case 2: return 2u * 1024 * 1024;
1908 default: return 4u * 1024 * 1024;
1909 }
1910}
1911
1912static inline bool s3_lfb_enabled(uint8_t cr58, uint16_t advfunc) {
1913 // Trio32/Trio64 DB014-B 18-3: ADVFUNC.LA is ORed with CR58.ENB LA.
1914 return ((cr58 | advfunc) & 0x10) != 0;
1915}
1916
1917bool CS3Trio64::uses_sized_linear_bar_window() const noexcept
1918{
1919 // DB014-B 13-1: enhanced mapping/functions precede linear addressing.
1920 const u16 advfunc = m_8514.ibm8514.advfunction_ctrl;
1921 return device_at[0] && (s3.memory_config & 0x08) && (advfunc & 0x01) &&
1922 !(s3.cr53 & 0x18) && !(advfunc & 0x20);
1923}
1924
1925u8 CS3Trio64::cpu_bank() const noexcept
1926{
1927 // DB014-B 17-13: nonzero CR6A overrides the older CR35/CR51 bank.
1928 const u8 extended = vga.crtc.data[0x6a] & 0x3f;
1929 return extended ? extended :
1930 (s3.crt_reg_lock & 0x0f) | ((s3.cr51 & 0x0c) << 2);
1931}
1932
1933bool CS3Trio64::linear_bar_offset(u64 address, u32& offset) const noexcept
1934{
1935 if (!(vga.miscellaneous_output & 0x02) ||
1936 !s3_lfb_enabled(s3.cr58, m_8514.ibm8514.advfunction_ctrl))
1937 return false;
1938
1939 // DB014-B 17-7/19-4: CR59:5A selects a size-aligned window inside BAR0.
1940 const u32 size = s3_lfb_size_from_cr58(s3.cr58);
1941 const u32 mask = endian_32(pci_state.config_mask[0][4]) & 0xfffffff0U;
1942 const u32 position = (u32(s3.cr59) << 24) | (u32(s3.cr5a) << 16);
1943 const u32 start = (position & ~mask) & ~(size - 1U);
1944 if (address < start || address - start >= size)
1945 return false;
1946 offset = u32(address - start);
1947 // DB014-B 15-2/17-13: CR31.CPUA BASE enables the 64 KiB page offset.
1948 if (!(s3.cr58 & 0x03) && (s3.memory_config & 0x01))
1949 offset += u32(cpu_bank()) << 16;
1950 return true;
1951}
1952
1953void CS3Trio64::update_linear_mapping()
1954{
1955 // BAR-only mode: no per-device mapping. PCI core decodes BAR0 and gates
1956 // access via COMMAND.MSE. lfb_active gates the framebuffer handlers.
1957 lfb_active = s3_lfb_enabled(m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x58), m_8514.ibm8514.advfunction_ctrl);
1958 lfb_size = s3_lfb_size_from_cr58(m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x58));
1959 lfb_base = s3_lfb_base_from_regs();
1960#ifdef S3_LFB_TRACE
1961 printf("%s: LFB (BAR-only): CR58=%02x base=%08x size=%x active=%d\n",
1962 devid_string, m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x58), lfb_base, lfb_size, lfb_active);
1963#endif
1964}
1965
1966void CS3Trio64::update_pci_bar0_from_crtc(u32 value, u32 register_bits)
1967{
1968 if (!device_at[0])
1969 return;
1970 // DB014-B 17-7/19-4: reflect only this register's implemented shared bits.
1971 const u32 mask = endian_32(pci_state.config_mask[0][4]);
1972 const u32 shared = register_bits & mask & 0xff800000U;
1973 if (!shared)
1974 return;
1975 const u32 bar0 = (endian_32(pci_state.config_data[0][4]) & ~shared) | (value & shared);
1976 pci_state.config_data[0][4] = endian_32(bar0);
1977 // This is an address assignment, including a same-value write after a PCI
1978 // sizing probe. Avoid PCI callbacks that would rewrite the other CR alias.
1979 register_bar(0, 0, bar0, mask);
1980}
1981
1982void CS3Trio64::on_crtc_linear_regs_changed(const char* reason)
1983{
1984 const u8 cr58 = m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x58);
1985 const u8 cr59 = m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x59);
1986 const u8 cr5a = m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x5A);
1987
1988 // Either CR58.ENB LA or ADVFUNC.LA enables linear addressing.
1989 lfb_active = s3_lfb_enabled(cr58, m_8514.ibm8514.advfunction_ctrl);
1990
1991 // Trio64 size: CR58[1:0] 00=64K, 01=1M, 10=2M, 11=4M
1992 lfb_size = s3_lfb_size_from_cr58(cr58);
1993
1994 // Base: CR59:CR5A form LA_WINDOW; reported/programmed as (la_window << 16)
1995 const u32 la_window = (u32(cr59) << 8) | u32(cr5a);
1996 lfb_base = la_window << 16;
1997
1998 // Apply/unapply the mapping now that CR regs changed
1999 lfb_recalc_and_map();
2000 trace_lfb_if_changed(reason);
2001}
2002
2006void CS3Trio64::init()
2007{
2008 // Register PCI device
2009 add_function(0, s3_cfg_data, s3_cfg_mask);
2010
2011 // Make the 21272/21274 PCI config window visible for this device now.
2012 // NetBSD reads PCI_ID_REG at 0/1/0 during console bring-up; without this
2013 // mapping it sees ~0/0 and panics with "no device at 255/255/0".
2014 ResetPCI();
2015
2016
2017 // Initialize all state variables to 0
2018 memset((void*)&state, 0, sizeof(state));
2019
2020 // initialize MAME S3 and VGA fields and values to 0
2021 memset(&s3, 0, sizeof(s3));
2022 memset(&vga, 0, sizeof(vga));
2023 memset(&svga, 0, sizeof(svga));
2024 memset(&timing, 0, sizeof(timing));
2025 m_scan = {};
2026 m_scan_initialized = false;
2027 m_scan_paused = false;
2028 memset(vga.dac.color, 0, sizeof(vga.dac.color));
2029 memset(vga.dac.loading, 0, sizeof(vga.dac.loading));
2030
2031 // Register VGA I/O ports at 3b4, 3b5, 3ba, 3c0..cf, 3d4, 3d5, 3da
2032 add_legacy_io(1, 0x3b4, 2);
2033 add_legacy_io(3, 0x3ba, 2);
2034 add_legacy_io(2, 0x3c0, 16);
2035 add_legacy_io(8, 0x3d4, 2);
2036 add_legacy_io(9, 0x3da, 1);
2037 add_legacy_io(32, 0x102, 1);
2038
2039 // Register CRTC address-map handlers. Must be called before any
2040 // m_crtc_map.write_byte() so that writes dispatch through handlers
2041 // and update decomposed vga.crtc.* / s3.* fields + trigger recomputes.
2042 init_maps();
2043
2044 vga.attribute.state = atc_flip_flop() ? 1 : 0;
2045 vga.attribute.index = vga.attribute.index & 0x1f;
2046
2047 vga.gc.bit_mask = 0xFF;
2048
2049 vga.sequencer.char_sel.base[0] = 0x20000; // font B (attr bit3=0)
2050 vga.sequencer.char_sel.base[1] = 0x20000; // font A (attr bit3=1)
2051
2052 // 8514/A-style S3 accel ports (byte-wide) - always register;
2053 // runtime gating is done via CR40 (state.accel.enabled).
2054 add_legacy_io(10, 0x42E8, 2); // SUBSYS_CNTL/STAT
2055 add_legacy_io(11, 0x4AE8, 2); // ADVFUNC_CNTL
2056 add_legacy_io(12, 0x46E8, 2); // MODE_SETUP / video subsystem enable
2057 add_legacy_io(13, 0x4EE8, 2); // legacy compatibility stub
2058 add_legacy_io(14, 0x86E8, 2); // CUR_X
2059 add_legacy_io(15, 0x8EE8, 2); // DESTX_DIASTP
2060 add_legacy_io(16, 0x96E8, 2); // MAJ_AXIS_PCNT
2061 add_legacy_io(17, 0x9AE8, 2); // CMD
2062 add_legacy_io(18, 0xA2E8, 4); // BKGD_COLOR
2063 add_legacy_io(19, 0xA6E8, 4); // FRGD_COLOR
2064 add_legacy_io(20, 0xAAE8, 4); // WRT_MASK
2065 add_legacy_io(21, 0xAEE8, 4); // RD_MASK
2066 add_legacy_io(22, 0xB6E8, 2); // BKGD_MIX
2067 add_legacy_io(23, 0xBAE8, 2); // FRGD_MIX
2068 add_legacy_io(24, 0xE2E8, 8); // PIX_TRANS (0xE2E8..0xE2EF)
2069 add_legacy_io(25, 0xB2E8, 4); // PIX_CNTL or ALT PIX_TRANS (gated by MULTIFUNC[E].bit8)
2070 add_legacy_io(26, 0xBEE8, 2); // MULTIFUNC_CNTL (word)
2071 add_legacy_io(27, 0xD2E8, 2); // ROP_MIX (word; some paths read this)
2072 add_legacy_io(28, 0x9EE8, 2); // SHORT_STROKE (word; latch)
2073 add_legacy_io(29, 0xCAE8, 2); // DESTY/AXSTP alias (might be wrong)
2074 add_legacy_io(30, 0x82E8, 2); // CUR_Y
2075 add_legacy_io(31, 0x92E8, 2); // ERR_TERM
2076 add_legacy_io(33, 0x8AE8, 2); // DESTY_AXSTP
2077
2078 // Legacy video address space: A0000 -> bffff
2079 add_legacy_mem(4, 0xa0000, 128 * 1024);
2080
2081 // Default: no linear window until guest enables CR58 or ADVFUNC bit 4.
2082 // Seed base/size from PCI config defaults; CR58/59 will override when written.
2083 lfb_active = false;
2084 lfb_base = s3_cfg_data[0x10 >> 2] & s3_cfg_mask[0x10 >> 2];
2085 lfb_size = vga.svga_intf.vram_size; // clamp to VRAM for now
2086
2087 // Reset the base PCI device
2088 ResetPCI();
2089
2090 /* The configuration file variable "rom" should point to a VGA BIOS
2091 image. If not, try "vgabios.bin". */
2092 FILE* rom = fopen(myCfg->get_text_value("rom", "vgabios.bin"), "rb");
2093 if (!rom)
2094 {
2095 FAILURE_1(FileNotFound, "s3 rom file %s not found",
2096 myCfg->get_text_value("rom", "vgabios.bin"));
2097 }
2098
2099 rom_max = (unsigned)fread(option_rom, 1, sizeof(option_rom), rom);
2100 fclose(rom);
2101
2102 vga.attribute.state = 1;
2103
2104 vga.crtc.line_compare = 1023;
2105 vga.crtc.vert_disp_end = 399;
2106
2107 vga.dac.mask = 0xff;
2108 vga.dac.dirty = 1;
2109 vga.dac.state = 0;
2110 vga.dac.read = 0;
2111
2112 vga.gc.memory_map_sel = 2; // monochrome text mode
2113
2114 vga.sequencer.data[0] = 0x03; // reset1=1, reset2=1
2115 vga.sequencer.data[4] = 0x06; // extended_mem=1, odd_even=1, chain_four=0
2116 s3.sr15 = 0; // CLKSYN Control 2 Register (SR15) 00H poweron
2117 vga.sequencer.data[0x0A] = 0; // External Bus Control Register (SRA) 00H poweron
2118 vga.sequencer.data[0x0B] = 0; // Miscellaneous Extended Sequencer Register 00H poweron
2119 vga.sequencer.data[0x0D] = 0; // Extended Sequencer Register (EX_SR_D) (SRD) 00H poweron
2120 vga.sequencer.data[0x09] = 0; // Extended Sequencer Register 9 (SR9) poweron 00H
2121
2122 // MCLK PLL defaults (MAME values)
2123 s3.sr10 = 0x42;
2124 s3.sr11 = 0x41;
2125
2126 // DCLK PLL defaults (MAME values)
2127 s3.sr12 = 0x00;
2128 s3.sr13 = 0x00;
2129 s3.clk_pll_n = 0x00;
2130 s3.clk_pll_r = 0x00;
2131
2132 // Use VIDEO_RAM_SIZE (in bits) to size VRAM. With 22 this is 4 MB.
2133 vga.svga_intf.vram_size = 1u << VIDEO_RAM_SIZE;
2134 vga.memory = new u8[vga.svga_intf.vram_size];
2135 memset(vga.memory, 0, vga.svga_intf.vram_size);
2136
2137 state.last_bpp = 8;
2138
2139 state.x_tilesize = X_TILESIZE;
2140 state.y_tilesize = Y_TILESIZE;
2141
2142 s3.id_cr30 = 0xE1; // Chip ID/REV register CR30, dosbox-x implementation returns 0x00 for our use case. poweron default is E1H however.
2143 m_crtc_map.write_byte(0x32, 0x00); // Locked by default
2144 m_crtc_map.write_byte(0x33, 0x00); // CR33 (Backward Compatibility 2) default 00h (no locks).
2145 m_crtc_map.write_byte(0x36, s3_cr36_from_memsize(vga.svga_intf.vram_size, true)); // Configuration 2 Register (CONFG_REG1) (CR36) - bootstrap config
2146 m_crtc_map.write_byte(0x37, 0xE5); // Configuration 2 Register (CONFG_REG2) (CR37) - bootstrap read, sane value from 86box
2147 m_crtc_map.write_byte(0x3B, 0x00); // CR3B: Data Transfer Position (DTPC)
2148 m_crtc_map.write_byte(0x3C, 0x00); // CR3C: IL_RTSTART defaulting
2149 m_crtc_map.write_byte(0x40, 0x30); // System Configuration Register, power on default 30h
2150 m_crtc_map.write_byte(0x42, 0x00); // Mode Control 2- can set interlace vs non
2151 s3.strapping = (uint32_t)s3_cr36_from_memsize(vga.svga_intf.vram_size, true);
2152 vga.gc.memory_map_sel = 3; // color text mode
2153 state.vga_mem_updated = 1;
2154
2155 // init MAME fields
2156 s3.id_high = 0x88; // 86C764 Trio64
2157 s3.id_low = 0x11;
2158 s3.revision = 0x00;
2159 s3.id_cr30 = 0xE1; // Trio64 (per datasheet)
2160
2161 // lets make it decent - redraw time
2162 timing.vrefresh_hz = 60.0;
2163 timing.refresh_interval_ms = 16; // ~60Hz
2164 m_last_refresh_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
2165
2166 // Hardware cursor defaults (MAME says windows 95 doesn't program these but it applies it regardless to everything)
2167 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
2168 s3.cursor_fg[i] = 0xFF;
2169 s3.cursor_bg[i] = 0x00;
2170 }
2171
2172 // CR56: External Sync Control 1 (EX_SYNC_1) power-on default 00h
2173 m_crtc_map.write_byte(0x56, 0x00);
2174
2175 // CR57: EX_SYNC_2 (VSYNC reset adjust), power-on default 00h
2176 m_crtc_map.write_byte(0x57, 0x00);
2177
2178 // EX_SYNC_3 (CR63)
2179 m_crtc_map.write_byte(0x63, 0x00);
2180
2181 // CNFG-REG-3 (CR68) poweron strap; datasheet says power-on samples PD[23:16].
2182 // 00h per 86Box-compatible. If needed, set CRTC.reg[0x68] before
2183 // recompute_config3() for different.
2184 m_crtc_map.write_byte(0x68, 0x00);
2185
2186 // CR65: Extended Miscellaneous Control Register (EXT-MISC-CTL) (CR65)
2187 m_crtc_map.write_byte(0x65, 0x00);
2188
2189 m_8514.set_vga_ptr(this);
2190 m_8514.start();
2191
2192 refresh_pitch_offset(); // do it initially, just for sanity sake
2193
2194 myThread = 0;
2195
2196 printf("%s: $Id$\n",
2197 devid_string);
2198}
2199
2200
2201void CS3Trio64::recompute_scanline_layout()
2202{
2203 const uint8_t cr5d = m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x5d);
2204
2205 auto xbit = [&](int b) -> uint16_t { return (cr5d >> b) & 1u; };
2206
2207 // still some compute/reliance, need to sync up here...
2208
2209 // vga.crtc.horz_total - MAME sets low 8, we overlay bit8 from CR5D.
2210 vga.crtc.horz_total = (vga.crtc.horz_total & 0xff) | (xbit(0) << 8);
2211
2212 // vga.crtc.horz_disp_end — same pattern.
2213 vga.crtc.horz_disp_end = (vga.crtc.horz_disp_end & 0xff) | (xbit(1) << 8);
2214
2215 // vga.crtc.horz_blank_start — can only hold low 8 bits.
2216 // Compose full 9-bit value
2217 vga.crtc.horz_blank_start = uint16_t(vga.crtc.horz_blank_start) | (xbit(2) << 8);
2218
2219 // vga.crtc.horz_retrace_start — same.
2220 vga.crtc.horz_retrace_start = uint16_t(vga.crtc.horz_retrace_start) | (xbit(4) << 8);
2221
2222 // vga.crtc.horz_blank_end, holds bits 0-5 (CR03 + CR05).
2223 uint16_t hb_end_base = uint16_t(vga.crtc.horz_blank_end & 0x3f);
2224 vga.crtc.horz_blank_end = hb_end_base + (xbit(3) ? 64 : 0);
2225
2226 // vga.crtc.horz_retrace_end, holds bits 0-4 (from CR05).
2227 uint16_t hs_end_base = uint16_t(vga.crtc.horz_retrace_end & 0x1f);
2228 vga.crtc.horz_retrace_end = hs_end_base + (xbit(5) ? 32 : 0);
2229
2230 // S3 special blanking (CR33 bit5)
2231 if (m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x33) & 0x20) {
2232 vga.crtc.horz_blank_start = vga.crtc.horz_disp_end;
2233 vga.crtc.horz_blank_end = (vga.crtc.horz_total - 1) & 0x1FF;
2234 }
2235
2236 // 9-bit masking
2237 vga.crtc.horz_total &= 0x1FF;
2238 vga.crtc.horz_disp_end &= 0x1FF;
2239 vga.crtc.horz_blank_start &= 0x1FF;
2240 vga.crtc.horz_blank_end &= 0x1FF;
2241 vga.crtc.horz_retrace_start &= 0x1FF;
2242 vga.crtc.horz_retrace_end &= 0x1FF;
2243}
2244
2245void CS3Trio64::recompute_params()
2246{
2247 recompute_scanline_layout();
2248 refresh_pitch_offset();
2249 redraw_area(0, 0, old_iWidth, old_iHeight);
2250}
2251
2252void CS3Trio64::attribute_map(address_map& map)
2253{
2254 vga_device::attribute_map(map);
2255
2256 // Palette Index Registers 0x00..0x0f
2257 map(0x00, 0x0f).lw8(
2258 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
2259 // CR33 bit6: Lock Palette/Overscan Registers
2260 if (m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x33) & 0x40)
2261 return;
2262 u8 idx = offset & 0x0f;
2263 if (vga.attribute.data[idx] != (data & 0x3f)) {
2264 vga.attribute.data[idx] = data & 0x3f;
2265 redraw_area(0, 0, old_iWidth, old_iHeight);
2266 }
2267 })
2268 );
2269
2270 // Preserve ES40's existing 0xff readback here; writes retain the base no-op.
2271 map(0x20, 0x2f).lr8(NAME([](offs_t) { return u8(0xff); }));
2272
2273 // Mode Control (index 0x10, mirrored at 0x30)
2274 map(0x10, 0x10).mirror(0x20).lw8(
2275 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
2276 const u8 prev = vga.attribute.data[0x10];
2277 vga.attribute.data[0x10] = data & 0x3f; // MAME canonical
2278
2279 // ES40 side-effects: detect bit changes from previous value
2280 if (BIT(data, 2) != BIT(prev, 2)) { // enable_line_graphics
2281 m_output.display().lock();
2282 m_output.display().set_text_charmap(
2283 &vga.memory[0x20000 + vga.sequencer.char_sel.A]);
2284 m_output.display().unlock();
2285 state.vga_mem_updated = 1;
2286 }
2287 if (BIT(data, 7) != BIT(prev, 7)) { // internal_palette_size
2288 redraw_area(0, 0, old_iWidth, old_iHeight);
2289 }
2290 })
2291 );
2292
2293 // Overscan Color (index 0x11, mirrored at 0x31)
2294 map(0x11, 0x11).mirror(0x20).lw8(
2295 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
2296 // CR33 bit6: Lock Palette/Overscan Registers
2297 if (m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x33) & 0x40)
2298 return;
2299 vga.attribute.data[0x11] = data & 0x3f; // MAME canonical
2300 })
2301 );
2302
2303 // Color Plane Enable (index 0x12, mirrored at 0x32)
2304 map(0x12, 0x12).mirror(0x20).lw8(
2305 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
2306 vga.attribute.data[0x12] = data & 0x3f; // MAME canonical
2307 redraw_area(0, 0, old_iWidth, old_iHeight);
2308 })
2309 );
2310
2311 // Horizontal PEL Shift (index 0x13, mirrored at 0x33)
2312 map(0x13, 0x13).mirror(0x20).lw8(
2313 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
2314 vga.attribute.pel_shift_latch = data & 0xf; // MAME canonical
2315 vga.attribute.data[0x13] = data & 0xf; // MAME canonical
2316 redraw_area(0, 0, old_iWidth, old_iHeight);
2317 })
2318 );
2319
2320 // Color Select (index 0x14, mirrored at 0x34)
2321 map(0x14, 0x14).mirror(0x20).lw8(
2322 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
2323 vga.attribute.pel_shift_latch = data & 0xf; // MAME canonical (yes, same field)
2324 vga.attribute.data[0x14] = data & 0xf; // MAME canonical
2325 redraw_area(0, 0, old_iWidth, old_iHeight);
2326 })
2327 );
2328}
2329
2330/**************************************
2331 *
2332 * GC
2333 *
2334 *************************************/
2335
2336void CS3Trio64::gc_map(address_map& map)
2337{
2338 vga_device::gc_map(map);
2339 // Preserve ES40 redraw and dimension-cache updates for VGA mode changes.
2340 map(0x06, 0x06).lw8(
2341 NAME([this](offs_t offset, u8 data) {
2342 u8 prev_memory_mapping = vga.gc.memory_map_sel; //es40ism
2343 bool prev_alpha_dis = vga.gc.alpha_dis; // es40ism
2344 // MAME
2345 vga.gc.memory_map_sel = (data & 0xc) >> 2;
2346 vga.gc.chain_oe = BIT(data, 1);
2347 vga.gc.alpha_dis = BIT(data, 0);
2348 // ES40 side-effects: redraw on mapping/mode change
2349 if (prev_memory_mapping != vga.gc.memory_map_sel)
2350 redraw_area(0, 0, old_iWidth, old_iHeight);
2351 if (prev_alpha_dis != vga.gc.alpha_dis) {
2352 redraw_area(0, 0, old_iWidth, old_iHeight);
2353 old_iHeight = 0;
2354 }
2355 })
2356 );
2357}
2358
2359// DB014-B 9-1 and 14-13/16. PLL lock delay is not simulated; a permitted
2360// load takes effect at this transaction's sampled time. SR15.1 permits repeated
2361// loading, while SR15.5 requests an immediate load. SR12/13 alone are staging
2362// registers while both controls are clear.
2363void CS3Trio64::load_dclk()
2364{
2365 if (!(s3.sr15 & 0x22))
2366 return;
2367 const u32 source = (vga.miscellaneous_output >> 2) & 3;
2368 if (source == 2)
2369 return; // reserved selection: leave the active oscillator unchanged
2370 m_scan.dclk_source = source;
2371 if (source == 3) {
2372 s3.clk_pll_n = s3.sr12 & 0x1f;
2373 s3.clk_pll_r = (s3.sr12 >> 5) & 3;
2374 s3.clk_pll_m = s3.sr13 & 0x7f;
2375 }
2376 // The book specifies the two nominal VGA rates but not the automatic
2377 // SR12/13 preset encodings; their inherited readback is left unchanged.
2378 s3_define_video_mode();
2379}
2380
2381CS3Trio64::ScanTiming CS3Trio64::scan_timing() const
2382{
2383 ScanTiming t{};
2384 // Horizontal start fields in the inherited VGA structure are only bytes.
2385 // CR5D retains the additional bits, independently of those render caches.
2386 t.horizontal_total = ((vga.crtc.horz_total & 0xff) |
2387 ((s3.cr5d & 1) << 8)) + 5;
2388 t.horizontal_retrace_start = vga.crtc.horz_retrace_start |
2389 ((s3.cr5d & 0x10) << 4);
2390 t.vertical_total = (vga.crtc.vert_total & 0x7ff) + 2;
2391 t.vertical_retrace_start = vga.crtc.vert_retrace_start & 0x7ff;
2392 t.vertical_retrace_width = ((vga.crtc.vert_retrace_end -
2393 t.vertical_retrace_start - 1) & 15) + 1;
2394 t.vertical_divisor = vga.crtc.sldiv ? 2 : 1;
2395 t.interlace = (s3.cr42 & 0x20) != 0;
2396 t.interlace_offset = s3.cr3c;
2397 t.sync_enabled = vga.crtc.sync_en != 0;
2398
2399 double dclk = 0.0;
2400 switch (m_scan.dclk_source) {
2401 case 0: dclk = 25175000.0; break;
2402 case 1: dclk = 28322000.0; break;
2403 case 3:
2404 dclk = 14318180.0 * (s3.clk_pll_m + 2) /
2405 ((s3.clk_pll_n + 2) * (1u << (s3.clk_pll_r & 3)));
2406 break;
2407 default: break; // rejected when restoring a saved clock source
2408 }
2409 // SR14.0 powers down DCLK; no external test clock is connected to SR14.7.
2410 if (vga.sequencer.data[0x14] & 0x81)
2411 dclk = 0.0;
2412 // SR15.4 divides the RAMDAC VCLK path, not the CRTC character clock
2413 // (DB014-B 9-3). Clock-doubled DAC output does not double these counters.
2414 double dots_per_character = (vga.sequencer.data[1] & 1) ? 8.0 : 9.0;
2415 if (vga.sequencer.data[1] & 8)
2416 dots_per_character *= 2.0;
2417 if (s3.cr43 & 0x80)
2418 dots_per_character *= 2.0;
2419 // The Trio's one-clock 15/16-bit modes use half-sized horizontal units.
2420 // Their drivers program twice as many CRTC character counts (CR67=3/5).
2421 const u8 color_mode = s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2 >> 4;
2422 if (color_mode == 3 || color_mode == 5)
2423 dots_per_character /= 2.0;
2424 t.characters_per_second = dclk / dots_per_character;
2425 // Modular end comparators wrap to the next match, including equal low
2426 // bits (32 horizontal / 16 vertical). The equal-edge priority is not
2427 // specified by the book; this follows the conventional VGA counter model.
2428 // DB014-B labels CR5D.5 "+32 DCLKs", but the S3 Xorg driver programs it
2429 // for sync widths exceeding 32 CHARACTER clocks. Add a width extension;
2430 // ORing an endpoint bit loses it when the low comparator already wraps.
2431 t.horizontal_retrace_width = ((vga.crtc.horz_retrace_end -
2432 t.horizontal_retrace_start - 1) & 31) + 1;
2433 if (s3.cr5d & 0x20)
2434 t.horizontal_retrace_width += 32.0;
2435 // CR05.6:5 delays the complete HSYNC pulse by up to three character
2436 // clocks; it does not change the end comparator's pulse width (14-22).
2437 if (t.horizontal_retrace_start < t.horizontal_total)
2438 t.horizontal_retrace_start = (t.horizontal_retrace_start +
2439 vga.crtc.horz_retrace_skew) % t.horizontal_total;
2440 return t;
2441}
2442
2443void CS3Trio64::advance_scan(std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point now)
2444{
2445 // A nested bus access can sample a later instant before the outer access
2446 // resumes. Never rewind a running counter's anchor and count time twice.
2447 if (m_scan_initialized && !m_scan_paused && now < m_scan_time)
2448 return;
2449 const ScanTiming t = scan_timing();
2450 const u32 field_lines = t.vertical_total * t.vertical_divisor;
2451 // Mode programming does not restart the oscillator. Retain the counters
2452 // and reduce out-of-range positions when software changes the totals.
2453 m_scan.character = std::fmod(m_scan.character, double(t.horizontal_total));
2454 m_scan.line %= field_lines;
2455 if (!t.interlace)
2456 m_scan.field = 0;
2457 if (m_scan_initialized && !m_scan_paused && now > m_scan_time &&
2458 t.characters_per_second > 0.0) {
2459 const double seconds = std::chrono::duration<double>(now - m_scan_time).count();
2460 const double field_characters = double(t.horizontal_total) * field_lines;
2461 const double cycle_characters = field_characters * (t.interlace ? 2 : 1);
2462 // Reduce elapsed time before combining it with the saved position; a
2463 // long host pause must not overflow an integer scan counter.
2464 double position = m_scan.character + double(m_scan.line) * t.horizontal_total;
2465 if (t.interlace)
2466 position += m_scan.field * field_characters;
2467 position = std::fmod(position + std::fmod(seconds * t.characters_per_second,
2468 cycle_characters), cycle_characters);
2469 m_scan.field = t.interlace && position >= field_characters;
2470 position = std::fmod(position, field_characters);
2471 m_scan.line = u32(position / t.horizontal_total);
2472 m_scan.character = std::fmod(position, double(t.horizontal_total));
2473 }
2474 m_scan_time = now;
2475 m_scan_initialized = true;
2476}
2477
2478u8 CS3Trio64::scan_status(std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point now)
2479{
2480 advance_scan(now);
2481 const ScanTiming t = scan_timing();
2482 // DB014-B 14-3: bit 0 is horizontal OR vertical retrace; bit 3 is
2483 // vertical retrace alone. Neither display-end nor blanking substitutes
2484 // for these pulses. Bit 2 reads one. Screen-off and DAC power-down do
2485 // not stop the CRTC; SR00's VGA reset bits have no function on Trio64.
2486 if (!t.sync_enabled)
2487 return 0x04;
2488 auto pulse = [](double position, double start, double width, double total) {
2489 return start < total && width > 0.0 &&
2490 std::fmod(position + total - start, total) < width;
2491 };
2492 const bool horizontal = pulse(m_scan.character, t.horizontal_retrace_start,
2493 t.horizontal_retrace_width, t.horizontal_total);
2494 const double line = m_scan.line + m_scan.character / t.horizontal_total;
2495 // Interlaced timings already describe a field. CR3C offsets alternate
2496 // field start/end by character clocks (DB014-B 15-11); no second halving
2497 // of the programmed vertical total is applied. External genlock and
2498 // sub-character PLL/sync propagation delays are not modeled.
2499 const double field_lines = t.vertical_total * t.vertical_divisor;
2500 const double start = t.vertical_retrace_start * t.vertical_divisor;
2501 const double width = t.vertical_retrace_width * t.vertical_divisor;
2502 bool vertical = false;
2503 if (start < field_lines) {
2504 if (t.interlace) {
2505 // Evaluate both pulses over the full frame so a pulse crossing a
2506 // field boundary retains the offset of the field that started it.
2507 const double position = m_scan.field * field_lines + line;
2508 const double odd_start = field_lines + start +
2509 double(t.interlace_offset) / t.horizontal_total;
2510 vertical = pulse(position, start, width, field_lines * 2.0) ||
2511 pulse(position, odd_start, width, field_lines * 2.0);
2512 } else {
2513 vertical = pulse(line, start, width, field_lines);
2514 }
2515 }
2516 return 0x04 | ((horizontal || vertical) ? 0x01 : 0) | (vertical ? 0x08 : 0);
2517}
2518
2519void CS3Trio64::recompute_params_clock(int divisor, int xtal)
2520{
2521 // Store timing parameters for renderer/debug use -- ES40 specific
2522 timing.xtal_hz = xtal;
2523 timing.divisor = divisor;
2524 // es40 specific end
2525
2526 if (!vga_device::recompute_params_clock(divisor, xtal,
2527 timing.vrefresh_hz, timing.refresh_interval_ms))
2528 return;
2529
2530 // ES40 specific here - MAME: pixel_clock = xtal / (((vga.sequencer.data[1]&8) >> 3) + 1);
2531 const int seq_div = ((vga.sequencer.data[1] & 0x08) >> 3) + 1;
2532 timing.pixel_clock_hz = (seq_div > 0) ? (xtal / seq_div) : xtal;
2533
2534 // Recompute line offset (pitch) — ES40's existing function
2535 refresh_pitch_offset();
2536
2537 // Mark display dirty so the renderer picks up changes
2538 state.vga_mem_updated = 1;
2539}
2540
2544void CS3Trio64::start_threads()
2545{
2546 {
2547 std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(cSystem->get_device_bus_mutex());
2548 advance_scan(cSystem->device_access_time());
2549 m_scan_paused = false;
2550 }
2551 // Repaint and resize through the normal GUI path after any resume.
2552 state.vga_mem_updated = true;
2553 state.last_bpp = 0;
2554 // Resume after reset if the thread already exists
2555 PauseThread.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
2556
2557 if (!myThread)
2558 {
2559 myThread = new CThread("s3");
2560 printf(" %s", myThread->getName().c_str());
2561 StopThread = false;
2562 myThread->start(*this);
2563 }
2564}
2565
2569void CS3Trio64::stop_threads()
2570{
2571 {
2572 std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(cSystem->get_device_bus_mutex());
2573 advance_scan(cSystem->device_access_time());
2574 m_scan_paused = true;
2575 }
2576 // During firmware reset, do NOT kill the S3 thread (it owns the SDL window).
2577 // Just pause it so the window stays alive.
2578 if (cSystem && cSystem->IsResetInProgress())
2579 {
2580 PauseThread.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
2581
2582 // Wait briefly until the S3 thread acknowledges pause
2583 if (myThread)
2584 {
2585 for (int spin = 0; spin < 600; spin++) // up to ~600ms
2586 {
2587 if (PauseAck.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
2588 break;
2589 CThread::sleep(1);
2590 }
2591 // Make it visible in the log whether we paused or stopped
2592 printf(" s3(pause)");
2593 }
2594 return;
2595 }
2596
2597 // Normal shutdown: actually stop the thread.
2598 StopThread = true;
2599 if (myThread)
2600 {
2601 printf(" %s", myThread->getName().c_str());
2602 myThread->join();
2603 delete myThread;
2604 myThread = 0;
2605 }
2606}
2607
2611CS3Trio64::~CS3Trio64()
2612{
2613 stop_threads();
2614}
2615
2616void CS3Trio64::ResetPCI()
2617{
2618 // Reset the setup controls and their address selector together (DB014-B
2619 // sections 5, 14.6 and 17-10). Scanout has its own enable controls.
2620 m_video_subsys_enable = 0;
2621 m_setup_option_select_0102 = 0;
2622 s3.cr65 = 0;
2623 CPCIDevice::ResetPCI();
2624}
2625
2626bool CS3Trio64::normal_access_enabled() const noexcept
2627{
2628 return (m_video_subsys_enable & 0x18) == 0x08 &&
2629 (m_setup_option_select_0102 & 0x01);
2630}
2631
2632bool CS3Trio64::io_access_enabled(u32 port, bool write) const noexcept
2633{
2634 // The selected setup register must remain writable to enter and leave
2635 // setup, including while asleep (DB014-B 11-1, 14-47/48).
2636 if (port == 0x3c3 || port == 0x46e8)
2637 return write && port == ((s3.cr65 & 0x04) ? 0x3c3U : 0x46e8U);
2638 if ((port > 0x46e8 && port <= 0x46eb) || (port > 0x0102 && port <= 0x0105))
2639 return false; // wider writes have no additional setup-register lanes
2640 if (port == 0x0102)
2641 return (m_video_subsys_enable & 0x10) != 0;
2642 return normal_access_enabled();
2643}
2644
2645bool CS3Trio64::decodes_memory_access(int index, u64 address, int dsize,
2646 bool write) const noexcept
2647{
2648 if (index >= PCI_RANGE_BASE)
2649 {
2650 if (!CPCIDevice::decodes_memory_access(index, address, dsize, write))
2651 return false;
2652 // PCI configuration and expansion-ROM decoding remain independent:
2653 // the ROM must be accessible before its code wakes the video core.
2654 if ((index - PCI_RANGE_BASE) % 8 < 6 && !normal_access_enabled())
2655 return false;
2656 if (index == PCI_RANGE_BASE && uses_sized_linear_bar_window())
2657 {
2658 u32 offset;
2659 return linear_bar_offset(address, offset);
2660 }
2661 return true;
2662 }
2663 if (index < 0 || index >= MAX_DEV_RANGES || !device_at[0])
2664 return false;
2665
2666 // Trio32/Trio64 DB014-B, sections 6.1.2 and 19 (COMMAND, bits 0/1):
2667 // PCI I/O and memory responses require their respective command enable.
2668 const u32 enable = dev_range_is_io[index] ? 1U : 2U;
2669 if ((pci_state.config_data[0][1] & endian_32(enable)) == 0)
2670 return false;
2671
2672 if (index == 12 || index == 32)
2673 return address == 0 && io_access_enabled(index == 12 ? 0x46e8U : 0x0102U, write);
2674 // PCI 2.1 section 3.7.1: the first addressed byte selects the target.
2675 // A later enabled lane (for example 3C3 in a word at disabled 3C2)
2676 // cannot make this card claim the access. Handlers still gate the lanes
2677 // of transactions that this card does claim.
2678 if (index == 2)
2679 {
2680 // COMMAND.5 makes RAMDAC writes passive: never assert DEVSEL for
2681 // a transaction starting at 3C6-3C9 (DB014-B 8-4, 19-2).
2682 if (write && address >= 6 && address <= 9 &&
2683 (pci_state.config_data[0][1] & endian_32(0x20U)))
2684 return false;
2685 return address < 16 && io_access_enabled(0x3c0U + (u32)address, write);
2686 }
2687 if (!normal_access_enabled())
2688 return false;
2689
2690 // DB014-B 14-1: MISC bit 0 selects the 3Bx/3Dx port group.
2691 const bool color_io = (vga.miscellaneous_output & 0x01) != 0;
2692 switch (index)
2693 {
2694 case 1: // 3B4/3B5
2695 case 3: // 3BA
2696 return !color_io;
2697 case 8: // 3D4/3D5
2698 case 9: // 3DA
2699 return color_io;
2700 case 4: // A0000-BFFFF, address is relative to A0000
2701 // MMIO decoding remains separate
2702 if ((s3.cr53 & 0x18) ||
2703 (m_8514.ibm8514.advfunction_ctrl & 0x20))
2704 return true;
2705
2706 // DB014-B 17-6 and 18-3: either linear-enable bit suppresses the
2707 // enhanced legacy window unless banking, 64 KiB size, and A0000
2708 // base are all selected.
2709 if (s3_lfb_enabled(s3.cr58, m_8514.ibm8514.advfunction_ctrl))
2710 {
2711 if (!(s3.memory_config & 0x08))
2712 return true;
2713 if (!(s3.memory_config & 0x01) || (s3.cr58 & 0x03) ||
2714 s3.cr59 != 0 || s3.cr5a != 0x0a)
2715 return false;
2716 }
2717
2718 // DB014-B 15-3: CR31 bit 3 overrides GR6 with a 64 KiB map at
2719 // A0000. MISC bit 1 still enables CPU display-memory access (14-1).
2720 if (s3.memory_config & 0x08)
2721 return (vga.miscellaneous_output & 0x02) && address < 0x10000;
2722
2723 // Packed/enhanced formats without CR31's forced map remain pending.
2724 if ((s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2 & 0xf0) ||
2725 (m_8514.ibm8514.advfunction_ctrl & 0x01))
2726 return true;
2727
2728 // DB014-B 14-1: MISC bit 1 enables CPU display-memory access.
2729 if (!(vga.miscellaneous_output & 0x02))
2730 return false;
2731
2732 // DB014-B 14-40: GR6 bits 3:2 select the CPU memory window.
2733 // Decline excluded addresses before reads load VGA latches or
2734 // writes consume an access intended for another responding device.
2735 switch (vga.gc.memory_map_sel & 0x03)
2736 {
2737 case 0: return address < 0x20000;
2738 case 1: return address < 0x10000;
2739 case 2: return address >= 0x10000 && address < 0x18000;
2740 case 3: return address >= 0x18000 && address < 0x20000;
2741 }
2742 return false;
2743 default:
2744 return true;
2745 }
2746}
2747
2748u64 CS3Trio64::capture_pci_io_write(const PciIoWrite& write) const noexcept
2749{
2750 // Freeze eligibility before any target callback. The token contains only
2751 // DAC byte lanes and CR34's master-abort handling, not serialized state.
2752 if (write.bus != myPCIBus || !device_at[0] ||
2753 (endian_32(pci_state.config_data[0][1]) & 0x21U) != 0x21U ||
2754 !normal_access_enabled() || (s3.cr33 & 0x10))
2755 return 0;
2756 if ((write.dsize != 8 && write.dsize != 16 && write.dsize != 32) ||
2757 (write.port & 3U) + write.dsize / 8 > 4 ||
2758 write.port < 0x3c4 || write.port > 0x3c9)
2759 return 0;
2760
2761 u64 captured = 0;
2762 for (int byte = 0; byte < write.dsize / 8; ++byte)
2763 if (write.port + byte >= 0x3c6 && write.port + byte <= 0x3c9)
2764 captured |= U64(1) << byte;
2765 if (!captured)
2766 return 0;
2767 // DB014-B 15-5: CR34.0/1 disable master-abort handling. Retry is
2768 // not represented by the synchronous dispatcher.
2769 if ((s3.cr34 & 3) == 0)
2770 captured |= 0x10;
2771 return captured;
2772}
2773
2774void CS3Trio64::observe_pci_io_write(const PciIoWrite& write, u64 captured,
2775 PciIoWriteDispatch dispatch)
2776{
2777 // PCI palette snoopers latch completed and master-aborted writes.
2778 // DB014-B does not give a disabled-mode timing table.
2779 // Observing never makes that unclaimed transaction a claimed one.
2780 if (dispatch == PciIoWriteDispatch::NoMappedTarget && !(captured & 0x10))
2781 return;
2782 for (int byte = 0; byte < write.dsize / 8; ++byte)
2783 if (captured & (U64(1) << byte))
2784 ramdac_write_b(write.port + byte, u8(write.data >> (byte * 8)));
2785}

2787std::string CS3Trio64::describe_access_context(int index, u64 address) const
2788{
2789 char text[160];
2790 snprintf(text, sizeof(text),
2791 "cmd %04x setup %02x opt %02x cr65 %02x misc %02x seq %02x gc %02x "
2792 "crtc %02x atc %02x/%u",
2793 (unsigned)(endian_32(pci_state.config_data[0][1]) & 0xffff),
2794 m_video_subsys_enable, m_setup_option_select_0102, s3.cr65,
2795 vga.miscellaneous_output, vga.sequencer.index, vga.gc.index,
2796 vga.crtc.index, vga.attribute.index, (unsigned)vga.attribute.state);
2797 return text;
2798}

2800/**
2801 * Read from one of the Legacy (fixed-address) memory ranges.
2802 **/
2803u32 CS3Trio64::ReadMem_Legacy(int index, u32 address, int dsize)
2804{
2805 if (!decodes_memory_access(index, address, dsize, false))
2806 return dsize == 8 ? 0xffU : dsize == 16 ? 0xffffU : 0xffffffffU;
2807 u32 data = 0;
2808 switch (index)
2809 {
2810 // IO Port 0x3b4
2811 case 1:
2812 data = io_read(address + 0x3b4, dsize);
2813 break;
2814
2815 // IO Port 0x3c0..0x3cf
2816 case 2:
2817 data = io_read(address + 0x3c0, dsize);
2818 break;
2819
2820 // IO Port 0x3ba
2821 case 3:
2822 data = io_read(address + 0x3ba, dsize);
2823 break;
2824
2825 // VGA Memory
2826 case 4:
2827 data = legacy_read(address, dsize);
2828 break;
2829
2830 // IO Port 0x3d4
2831 case 8:
2832 data = io_read(address + 0x3d4, dsize);
2833 break;
2834
2835 // IO Port 0x3da
2836 case 9:
2837 data = io_read(address + 0x3da, dsize);
2838 break;
2839
2840 case 10: data = io_read(address + 0x42E8, dsize); break;
2841 case 11: data = io_read(address + 0x4AE8, dsize); break;
2842 case 12: data = io_read(address + 0x46E8, dsize); break;
2843 case 13: data = io_read(address + 0x4EE8, dsize); break;
2844 case 14: data = io_read(address + 0x86E8, dsize); break;
2845 case 15: data = io_read(address + 0x8EE8, dsize); break;
2846 case 16: data = io_read(address + 0x96E8, dsize); break;
2847 case 17: data = io_read(address + 0x9AE8, dsize); break;
2848 case 18: data = io_read(address + 0xA2E8, dsize); break; // BKGD_COLOR
2849 case 19: data = io_read(address + 0xA6E8, dsize); break; // FRGD_COLOR
2850 case 20: data = io_read(address + 0xAAE8, dsize); break; // WRT_MASK
2851 case 21: data = io_read(address + 0xAEE8, dsize); break; // RD_MASK
2852 case 22: data = io_read(address + 0xB6E8, dsize); break; // BKGD_MIX
2853 case 23: data = io_read(address + 0xBAE8, dsize); break; // FRGD_MIX
2854 case 24: data = io_read(address + 0xE2E8, dsize); break; // PIX_TRANS (8 bytes)
2855 case 25: data = io_read(address + 0xB2E8, dsize); break;
2856 case 26: data = io_read(address + 0xBEE8, dsize); break;
2857 case 27: data = io_read(address + 0xD2E8, dsize); break;
2858 case 28: data = io_read(address + 0x9EE8, dsize); break;
2859 case 29: data = io_read(address + 0xCAE8, dsize); break;
2860 case 30: data = io_read(address + 0x82E8, dsize); break;
2861 case 31: data = io_read(address + 0x92E8, dsize); break;
2862 case 33: data = io_read(address + 0x8AE8, dsize); break;
2863
2864 case 32:
2865 data = io_read(address + 0x102, dsize);
2866 break;
2867 }
2868
2869 return data;
2870}
2871
2875void CS3Trio64::WriteMem_Legacy(int index, u32 address, int dsize, u32 data)
2876{
2877 if (!decodes_memory_access(index, address, dsize, true))
2878 return;
2879 switch (index)
2880 {
2881 // IO Port 0x3b4
2882 case 1:
2883 io_write(address + 0x3b4, dsize, data);
2884 return;
2885
2886 // IO Port 0x3c0..0x3cf
2887 case 2:
2888 io_write(address + 0x3c0, dsize, data);
2889 return;
2890
2891 // IO Port 0x3ba
2892 case 3:
2893 io_write(address + 0x3ba, dsize, data);
2894 return;
2895
2896 // VGA Memory
2897 case 4:
2898 legacy_write(address, dsize, data);
2899 return;
2900
2901 // IO Port 0x3d4
2902 case 8:
2903 io_write(address + 0x3d4, dsize, data);
2904 return;
2905
2906 // IO Port 0x3da
2907 case 9:
2908 io_write(address + 0x3da, dsize, data);
2909 return;
2910
2911 case 10: io_write(address + 0x42E8, dsize, data); break;
2912 case 11: io_write(address + 0x4AE8, dsize, data); break;
2913 case 12: io_write(address + 0x46E8, dsize, data); break;
2914 case 13: io_write(address + 0x4EE8, dsize, data); break;
2915 case 14: io_write(address + 0x86E8, dsize, data); break;
2916 case 15: io_write(address + 0x8EE8, dsize, data); break;
2917 case 16: io_write(address + 0x96E8, dsize, data); break;
2918 case 17: io_write(address + 0x9AE8, dsize, data); break;
2919 case 18: io_write(address + 0xA2E8, dsize, data); break; // BKGD_COLOR
2920 case 19: io_write(address + 0xA6E8, dsize, data); break; // FRGD_COLOR
2921 case 20: io_write(address + 0xAAE8, dsize, data); break; // WRT_MASK
2922 case 21: io_write(address + 0xAEE8, dsize, data); break; // RD_MASK
2923 case 22: io_write(address + 0xB6E8, dsize, data); break; // BKGD_MIX
2924 case 23: io_write(address + 0xBAE8, dsize, data); break; // FRGD_MIX
2925 case 24: io_write(address + 0xE2E8, dsize, data); break; // PIX_TRANS (8 bytes)
2926 case 25: io_write(address + 0xB2E8, dsize, data); break;
2927 case 26: io_write(address + 0xBEE8, dsize, data); break;
2928 case 27: io_write(address + 0xD2E8, dsize, data); break;
2929 case 28: io_write(address + 0x9EE8, dsize, data); break;
2930 case 29: io_write(address + 0xCAE8, dsize, data); break;
2931 case 30: io_write(address + 0x82E8, dsize, data); break;
2932 case 31: io_write(address + 0x92E8, dsize, data); break;
2933 case 33: io_write(address + 0x8AE8, dsize, data); break;
2934
2935 case 32:
2936 io_write(address + 0x102, dsize, data);
2937 return;
2938 }
2939}
2940
2941int CS3Trio64::BytesPerPixel() const
2942{
2943 const uint8_t pf = (s3.ext_misc_ctrl_2 >> 4) & 0x0F;
2944 switch (pf) {
2945 case 0x01: return 1; // Mode 8: 8-bit packed
2946 case 0x02: return 2; // Mode 1: 15-bit (2 VCLK/pixel)
2947 case 0x03: return 2; // Mode 9: 15-bit (1 VCLK/pixel)
2948 case 0x04: return 3; // Mode 2: 24-bit (3 VCLK/pixel)
2949 case 0x05: return 2; // Mode 10: 16-bit (1 VCLK/pixel)
2950 case 0x06: return 2; // Mode 3: 16-bit (2 VCLK/pixel)
2951 case 0x07: return 4; // Mode 11: 32-bit (2 VCLK/pixel)
2952 case 0x0D: return 4; // Mode 13: 32-bit alternate
2953 default: return 1; // Mode 0: 8bpp indexed (or VGA)
2954 }
2955}

2972
2973// -------------------------
2974// Minimal accel window I/O
2975// -------------------------
2976u8 CS3Trio64::AccelIORead(u32 port)
2977{
2978 ibm8514a_device* dev = get_8514();
2979 if (!s3.enable_8514) return 0xFF;
2980
2981 switch (port & 0xFFFE) {
2982 case 0x9AE8: {
2983 // Trio32/64 GP_STAT (DB014-B 18-10): bit 8 is reserved, and AE only tracks the command
2984 // FIFO, which is always drained here -- it stays set while HDW BSY waits on PIX_TRANS.
2985 const uint16_t ret = (dev->ibm8514_gpstatus_r() | 0x0400) & ~0x0100;
2986 return (port & 1) ? (uint8_t)(ret >> 8) : (uint8_t)(ret & 0xff);
2987 }
2988
2989 case 0x42E8: {
2990 uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_substatus_r();
2991 return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff);
2992 }
2993
2994 // coordinate & size readbacks
2995 case 0x82E8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_currenty_r(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
2996 case 0x86E8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_currentx_r(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
2997 case 0x8AE8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_desty_r(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
2998 case 0x8EE8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_destx_r(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
2999 case 0x92E8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_line_error_r(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3000 case 0x96E8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_width_r(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3001 case 0x9EE8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_ssv_r(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3002 case 0xA2E8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_bgcolour_r(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3003 case 0xA2EA: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_bgcolour_r_hi(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3004 case 0xA6E8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_fgcolour_r(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3005 case 0xA6EA: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_fgcolour_r_hi(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3006 case 0xAAE8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_write_mask_r(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3007 case 0xAAEA: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_write_mask_r_hi(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3008 case 0xAEE8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_read_mask_r(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3009 case 0xAEEA: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_read_mask_r_hi(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3010 case 0xB6E8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_backmix_r(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3011 case 0xBAE8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_foremix_r(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3012 case 0xB2E8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_color_cmp_r(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3013 case 0xB2EA: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_color_cmp_r_hi(); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3014 case 0xBEE8: { uint16_t v = dev->ibm8514_multifunc_r(m_video_subsys_enable); return (port & 1) ? (v >> 8) : (v & 0xff); }
3015
3016 default:
3017 return 0x00;
3018 }
3019}
3020
3021u32 CS3Trio64::AccelIORead(u32 port, int dsize)
3022{
3023 if (dsize != 8 && dsize != 16 && dsize != 32)
3024 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
3025 u32 result = 0;
3026 for (int lane = 0; lane < dsize / 8; ++lane)
3027 {
3028 // BEE8 is one register read, not two byte reads: READ_SEL advances
3029 // once for a word transaction (DB014-B 18-19/18-24).
3030 if (port + lane == 0xbee8 && lane + 1 < dsize / 8 && s3.enable_8514)
3031 {
3032 result |= (u32)m_8514.ibm8514_multifunc_r(m_video_subsys_enable) << (lane * 8);
3033 ++lane;
3034 }
3035 else
3036 result |= (u32)AccelIORead(port + lane) << (lane * 8);
3037 }
3038 return result;
3039}
3040
3041static inline void write16_low_high(u16& reg, u32 port, u8 data) {
3042 if ((port & 1) == 0) reg = (reg & 0xFF00u) | data;
3043 else reg = (reg & 0x00FFu) | (u16)data << 8;
3044}
3045
3046void CS3Trio64::AccelIOWrite(u32 port, u8 data)
3047{
3048 ibm8514a_device* dev = get_8514();
3049 if (!s3.enable_8514) return;
3050
3051 switch (port & 0xFFFE) {
3052
3053 // SUBSYS_CNTL (42E8h write)
3054 case 0x42E8: {
3055 const unsigned shift = (port & 1) * 8;
3056 dev->ibm8514_subcontrol_w(u16(data) << shift, u16(0xff) << shift);
3057 s3.mmio_42e8 = dev->ibm8514_subcontrol_r();
3058 break;
3059 }
3060
3061 // ADVFUNC_CNTL (4AE8h)
3062 case 0x4AE8:
3063 // The assembly mirror can be stale after accelerator reset or restore.
3064 s3.mmio_4ae8 = dev->ibm8514.advfunction_ctrl;
3065 write16_low_high(s3.mmio_4ae8, port, data);
3066 dev->ibm8514_advfunc_w(s3.mmio_4ae8);
3067 on_crtc_linear_regs_changed("ADVFUNC");
3068 break;
3069
3070 // CUR_Y (82E8h) — MAME sets prev_y too
3071 case 0x82E8:
3072 if ((port & 1) == 0) {
3073 dev->ibm8514.curr_y = (dev->ibm8514.curr_y & 0xff00) | data;
3074 dev->ibm8514.prev_y = (dev->ibm8514.prev_y & 0xff00) | data;
3075 }
3076 else {
3077 dev->ibm8514.curr_y = (dev->ibm8514.curr_y & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
3078 dev->ibm8514.prev_y = (dev->ibm8514.prev_y & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
3079 }
3080 break;
3081
3082 // CUR_X (86E8h) — MAME sets prev_x too
3083 case 0x86E8:
3084 if ((port & 1) == 0) {
3085 dev->ibm8514.curr_x = (dev->ibm8514.curr_x & 0xff00) | data;
3086 dev->ibm8514.prev_x = (dev->ibm8514.prev_x & 0xff00) | data;
3087 }
3088 else {
3089 dev->ibm8514.curr_x = (dev->ibm8514.curr_x & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
3090 dev->ibm8514.prev_x = (dev->ibm8514.prev_x & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
3091 }
3092 break;
3093
3094 // DESTY/AXSTP (8AE8h) — dual-purpose register
3095 case 0x8AE8:
3096 if ((port & 1) == 0) {
3097 dev->ibm8514.line_axial_step = (dev->ibm8514.line_axial_step & 0xff00) | data;
3098 dev->ibm8514.dest_y = (dev->ibm8514.dest_y & 0xff00) | data;
3099 }
3100 else {
3101 dev->ibm8514.line_axial_step = (dev->ibm8514.line_axial_step & 0x00ff) | ((data & 0x3f) << 8);
3102 dev->ibm8514.dest_y = (dev->ibm8514.dest_y & 0x00ff) | ((data & 0x0f) << 8);
3103 }
3104 break;
3105
3106 // COLOR_CMP (B2E8h)
3107 case 0xB2E8:
3108 case 0xB2EA:
3109 {
3110 unsigned s = (port & 3) * 8;
3111 dev->ibm8514.color_cmp = (dev->ibm8514.color_cmp & ~(0xFFu << s)) | ((u32)data << s);
3112 }
3113 break;
3114
3115 // DESTX/DIASTP (8EE8h) — dual-purpose register
3116 case 0x8EE8:
3117 if ((port & 1) == 0) {
3118 dev->ibm8514.line_diagonal_step = (dev->ibm8514.line_diagonal_step & 0xff00) | data;
3119 dev->ibm8514.dest_x = (dev->ibm8514.dest_x & 0xff00) | data;
3120 }
3121 else {
3122 dev->ibm8514.line_diagonal_step = (dev->ibm8514.line_diagonal_step & 0x00ff) | ((data & 0x3f) << 8);
3123 dev->ibm8514.dest_x = (dev->ibm8514.dest_x & 0x00ff) | ((data & 0x0f) << 8);
3124 }
3125 break;
3126
3127 // ERR_TERM (92E8h)
3128 case 0x92E8:
3129 if ((port & 1) == 0)
3130 s3.mmio_92e8 = (s3.mmio_92e8 & 0xff00) | data;
3131 else {
3132 s3.mmio_92e8 = (s3.mmio_92e8 & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
3133 dev->ibm8514_line_error_w(s3.mmio_92e8);
3134 }
3135 break;
3136
3137 // MAJ_AXIS_PCNT (96E8h)
3138 case 0x96E8:
3139 if ((port & 1) == 0)
3140 s3.mmio_96e8 = (s3.mmio_96e8 & 0xff00) | data;
3141 else {
3142 s3.mmio_96e8 = (s3.mmio_96e8 & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
3143 dev->ibm8514_width_w(s3.mmio_96e8);
3144 }
3145 break;
3146
3147 // CMD (9AE8h) — high byte triggers execution!
3148 case 0x9AE8:
3149 if ((port & 1) == 0)
3150 s3.mmio_9ae8 = (s3.mmio_9ae8 & 0xff00) | data;
3151 else {
3152 s3.mmio_9ae8 = (s3.mmio_9ae8 & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
3153 dev->ibm8514_cmd_w(s3.mmio_9ae8);
3154 }
3155 break;
3156
3157 // SSV (9EE8h) — high byte triggers execution
3158 case 0x9EE8:
3159 if ((port & 1) == 0)
3160 s3.mmio_9ee8 = (s3.mmio_9ee8 & 0xff00) | data;
3161 else {
3162 s3.mmio_9ee8 = (s3.mmio_9ee8 & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
3163 dev->ibm8514_ssv_w(s3.mmio_9ee8);
3164 }
3165 break;
3166
3167 // BKGD_COLOR (A2E8h)
3168 case 0xA2E8:
3169 case 0xA2EA:
3170 {
3171 unsigned s = (port & 3) * 8;
3172 dev->ibm8514.bgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.bgcolour & ~(0xFFu << s)) | ((u32)data << s);
3173 }
3174 break;
3175
3176 // FRGD_COLOR (A6E8h)
3177 case 0xA6E8:
3178 case 0xA6EA:
3179 {
3180 unsigned s = (port & 3) * 8;
3181 dev->ibm8514.fgcolour = (dev->ibm8514.fgcolour & ~(0xFFu << s)) | ((u32)data << s);
3182 }
3183 break;
3184
3185 // WRT_MASK (AAE8h)
3186 case 0xAAE8:
3187 case 0xAAEA:
3188 {
3189 unsigned s = (port & 3) * 8;
3190 dev->ibm8514.write_mask = (dev->ibm8514.write_mask & ~(0xFFu << s)) | ((u32)data << s);
3191 }
3192 break;
3193
3194 // RD_MASK (AEE8h)
3195 case 0xAEE8:
3196 case 0xAEEA:
3197 {
3198 unsigned s = (port & 3) * 8;
3199 dev->ibm8514.read_mask = (dev->ibm8514.read_mask & ~(0xFFu << s)) | ((u32)data << s);
3200 }
3201 break;
3202
3203 // BKGD_MIX (B6E8h)
3204 case 0xB6E8:
3205 if ((port & 1) == 0)
3206 dev->ibm8514.bgmix = (dev->ibm8514.bgmix & 0xff00) | data;
3207 else {
3208 dev->ibm8514.bgmix = (dev->ibm8514.bgmix & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
3209 dev->ibm8514.bkgd_sel = (dev->ibm8514.bgmix >> 5) & 3;
3210 dev->ibm8514.bkgd_mix_mode = dev->ibm8514.bgmix & 0x0f;
3211 }
3212 break;
3213
3214 // FRGD_MIX (BAE8h)
3215 case 0xBAE8:
3216 if ((port & 1) == 0)
3217 dev->ibm8514.fgmix = (dev->ibm8514.fgmix & 0xff00) | data;
3218 else {
3219 dev->ibm8514.fgmix = (dev->ibm8514.fgmix & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
3220 dev->ibm8514.frgd_sel = (dev->ibm8514.fgmix >> 5) & 3;
3221 dev->ibm8514.frgd_mix_mode = dev->ibm8514.fgmix & 0x0f;
3222 }
3223 break;
3224
3225 // MULTIFUNC_CNTL (BEE8h) — high byte triggers dispatch
3226 case 0xBEE8:
3227 if ((port & 1) == 0)
3228 s3.mmio_bee8 = (s3.mmio_bee8 & 0xff00) | data;
3229 else {
3230 s3.mmio_bee8 = (s3.mmio_bee8 & 0x00ff) | (data << 8);
3231 dev->ibm8514_multifunc_w(s3.mmio_bee8);
3232 }
3233 break;
3234
3235 // PIX_TRANS (E2E8h..E2EFh) — host data upload
3236 // Uses the ibm8514a's bus_size-aware accumulation + wait_draw()
3237 case 0xE2E8: case 0xE2EA: case 0xE2EC: case 0xE2EE:
3238 {
3239 if (dev->ibm8514.fifo_idx > 0) // byte-wise feed: drain the WAIT command's COUNT here
3240 dev->ibm8514.fifo_idx--;
3241 if (dev->ibm8514.bus_size == 0) {
3242 dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer & 0xffffff00) | data;
3243 dev->ibm8514_pixel_xfer_complete();
3244 }
3245 else if (dev->ibm8514.bus_size == 1) {
3246 if ((dev->ibm8514.current_cmd & 0x02) || (dev->ibm8514.color_bpp == 0)) {
3247 switch (port & 0x0001) {
3248 case 0: dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer & 0xffffff00) | data; break;
3249 case 1: dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer & 0xffff00ff) | (data << 8);
3250 dev->ibm8514_pixel_xfer_complete();
3251 break;
3252 }
3253 }
3254 else {
3255 switch (port & 0x0003) {
3256 case 0: dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer & 0xffffff00) | data; break;
3257 case 1: dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer & 0xffff00ff) | (data << 8); break;
3258 case 2: dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer & 0xff00ffff) | (data << 16); break;
3259 case 3: dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer & 0x00ffffff) | (data << 24);
3260 dev->ibm8514.bus_size = 2; // Windows NT background pattern hack
3261 dev->ibm8514_pixel_xfer_complete();
3262 break;
3263 }
3264 }
3265 }
3266 else if (dev->ibm8514.bus_size >= 2) {
3267 switch (port & 0x0003) {
3268 case 0: dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer & 0xffffff00) | data; break;
3269 case 1: dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer & 0xffff00ff) | (data << 8); break;
3270 case 2: dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer & 0xff00ffff) | (data << 16); break;
3271 case 3: dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer = (dev->ibm8514.pixel_xfer & 0x00ffffff) | (data << 24);
3272 dev->ibm8514_pixel_xfer_complete();
3273 break;
3274 }
3275 }
3276 break;
3277 }
3278
3279 default:
3280 LOG("%s: Accelerator unhandled I/O write port=%04x data=%02x\n", devid_string, port, data);
3281 break;
3282 }
3283}
3284
3285bool CS3Trio64::IsAccelPort(u32 p) const {
3286 switch (p & 0xFFFE) { // word regs, we accept low/high bytes
3287 // status/control
3288 case 0x42E8: // SUBSYS_CNTL / SUBSYS_STAT (w/r)
3289 case 0x4AE8: // ADVFUNC_CNTL
3290 // coordinates
3291 case 0x4EE8: // legacy compatibility stub
3292 case 0x82E8: // CUR_Y
3293 case 0x86E8: // CUR_X
3294 case 0x8AE8: // DESTY_AXSTP
3295 case 0x8EE8: // DESTX_DIASTP
3296 case 0xCAE8: // DESTY / AXSTP alias (seen in 86Box mappings)
3297 // dimensions / count
3298 case 0x96E8: // MAJ_AXIS_PCNT
3299 // mixes, masks, colors
3300 case 0xA2E8: // BKGD_COLOR
3301 case 0xA6E8: // FRGD_COLOR
3302 case 0xAAE8: // WRT_MASK
3303 case 0xAEE8: // RD_MASK
3304 case 0xB6E8: // BKGD_MIX
3305 case 0xBAE8: // FRGD_MIX
3306 // extra control regs used by some S3 paths
3307 case 0xD2E8: // ROP_MIX (word)
3308 case 0xBEE8: // MULTIFUNC_CNTL (word)
3309 case 0x9EE8: // SHORT_STROKE (word)
3310 case 0x9D48: // SSV (older window alias)
3311 case 0xB2E8: // COLOR_CMP (Color Compare register)
3312 case 0x9AE8: // CMD
3313 case 0x92E8:
3314 return true;
3315 default:
3316 break;
3317 }
3318 // Host data (PIX_TRANS): accept 0xE2E8..0xE2EF byte-wise for color fills
3319 if ((p & 0xFFF0u) == 0xE2E0u) return true; // PIX_TRANS/host
3320 return false;
3321}
3322
3326u32 CS3Trio64::ReadMem_Bar(int func, int bar, u32 address, int dsize)
3327{
3328 if (bar == 0 && !normal_access_enabled())
3329 return dsize == 8 ? 0xffU : dsize == 16 ? 0xffffU : 0xffffffffU;
3330#ifdef S3_LFB_TRACE
3331 if (lfb_trace_needs_first_access_note) {
3332 printf("%s: LFB first BAR access @+%llx size=%d\n",
3333 devid_string, (unsigned long long)address, dsize);
3334 lfb_trace_needs_first_access_note = false;
3335 }
3336#endif
3337
3338 switch (bar)
3339 {
3340 // PCI memory range
3341 case 0:
3342 if (func == 0 && uses_sized_linear_bar_window())
3343 {
3344 u32 offset;
3345 if (!linear_bar_offset(address, offset))
3346 return dsize == 8 ? 0xffU : dsize == 16 ? 0xffffU : 0xffffffffU;
3347 return mem_read(offset, dsize);
3348 }
3349 if (!lfb_active) {
3350 // No decode when LFB disabled  mimic bus-float/read-as-FFs
3351 return (dsize == 1) ? 0xFFu : (dsize == 2) ? 0xFFFFu : 0xFFFFFFFFu;
3352 }
3353 // Preserve the preceding data path for modes outside the scoped decoder.
3354 if (address >= 0xa0000 && address <= 0xbffff)
3355 return mem_r(address - 0xa0000);
3356 return mem_read(address, dsize);
3357 case 6:
3358 return func == 0 ? rom_read(address, dsize) : 0;
3359 }
3360
3361 return 0;
3362}
3363
3367void CS3Trio64::WriteMem_Bar(int func, int bar, u32 address, int dsize, u32 data)
3368{
3369 if (bar == 0 && !normal_access_enabled())
3370 return;
3371#ifdef DEBUG_PCI
3372 printf("%s: PCI BAR write func=%d bar=%d addr=%08X dsize=%d data=%08X\n",
3373 devid_string, func, bar, address, dsize, data);
3374#endif
3375#ifdef S3_LFB_TRACE
3376 if (lfb_trace_needs_first_access_note) {
3377 printf("%s: LFB first BAR access @+%llx size=%d (W)\n",
3378 devid_string, (unsigned long long)address, dsize);
3379 lfb_trace_needs_first_access_note = false;
3380 }
3381#endif
3382
3383 switch (bar)
3384 {
3385 // PCI Memory range
3386 case 0:
3387 if (func == 0 && uses_sized_linear_bar_window())
3388 {
3389 u32 offset;
3390 if (linear_bar_offset(address, offset))
3391 mem_write(offset, dsize, data);
3392 return;
3393 }
3394 if (!lfb_active) {
3395 // Ignore writes when LFB disabled
3396 return;
3397 }
3398 mem_write(address, dsize, data);
3399 return;
3400 }
3401}
3402
3403// --- Only include LFB here; legacy VGA paths fall through to vga_device ---
3404u64 CS3Trio64::ReadMem(int index, u64 address, int dsize)
3405{
3406 if (index == DEV_LFB_IDX && !normal_access_enabled())
3407 return dsize == 8 ? 0xffU : dsize == 16 ? 0xffffU : dsize == 32 ? 0xffffffffU : ~U64(0);
3408 // LFB window (registered by update_linear_mapping)
3409 if (index == DEV_LFB_IDX && lfb_active && lfb_size)
3410 {
3411 const u64 off = address; // dispatcher already subtracts base
3412 // Trio64 "new MMIO" 128 KiB window at LFB+0x0100_0000 (CR53 bit3)
3413 // - Lower half : PIX_TRANS FIFO (0xE2E8..0xE2EB) for 8/16/32-bit reads
3414 // - Upper half : 8514/A register mirror at *E8 offsets (IsAccelPort())
3415 if (s3_new_mmio_enabled()) {
3416#ifdef DEBUG_VGA
3417 printf("%s: New MMIO read offset=%08" PRIx64 " size=%d\n", devid_string, off, dsize);
3418#endif
3419 const u64 win_lo = 0x01000000ull;
3420 const u64 win_mid = 0x01008000ull;
3421 const u64 win_hi = 0x01020000ull;
3422 if (off >= win_lo && off < win_hi) {
3423 if (off < win_mid) {
3424 switch (dsize) {
3425 case 8:
3426 return (u64)AccelIORead(0xE2E8);
3427 case 16:
3428 return (u64)AccelIORead(0xE2E8) | ((u64)AccelIORead(0xE2E9) << 8);
3429 case 32:
3430 return (u64)AccelIORead(0xE2E8) | ((u64)AccelIORead(0xE2E9) << 8) | ((u64)AccelIORead(0xE2EA) << 16) | ((u64)AccelIORead(0xE2EB) << 24);
3431 default: FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
3432 }
3433 }
3434 else {
3435 const u32 p = (u32)(off - win_lo); // ports by offset
3436 if (IsAccelPort(p))
3437 return AccelIORead(p, dsize);
3438 }
3439 }
3440 }
3441 if (off >= lfb_size) return 0;
3442
3443 // Read little-endian from linear VRAM
3444 switch (dsize)
3445 {
3446 case 1: return vga.memory[off];
3447 case 2: return *(u16*)(vga.memory + off);
3448 case 4: return *(u32*)(vga.memory + off);
3449 case 8: {
3450 u64 v = *(u32*)(vga.memory + off);
3451 v |= (u64) * (u32*)(vga.memory + off + 4) << 32;
3452#ifdef S3_LFB_TRACE
3453 printf("%s: LFB R size=%d @%llx => %08" PRIx64 " (off=%llx)\n",
3454 devid_string, dsize, (unsigned long long)address,
3455 v, (unsigned long long)(address - lfb_base));
3456#endif
3457 return v;
3458 }
3459 default: // fall back byte-by-byte
3460 {
3461 u64 v = 0;
3462 for (int i = 0; i < dsize; ++i) v |= (u64)vga.memory[off + i] << (i * 8);
3463 return v;
3464 }
3465 }
3466 }
3467
3468 // Everything else (all legacy VGA ports & A0000 region, option ROM, etc.)
3469 return vga_device::ReadMem(index, address, dsize);
3470}
3471
3472void CS3Trio64::WriteMem(int index, u64 address, int dsize, u64 data)
3473{
3474 if (index == DEV_LFB_IDX && !normal_access_enabled())
3475 return;
3476 if (index == DEV_LFB_IDX && lfb_active && lfb_size)
3477 {
3478 const u64 off = address; // dispatcher already subtracts base
3479 // Trio64 "new MMIO" 128 KiB window at LFB+0x0100_0000 (CR53 bit3)
3480 // - Lower half : PIX_TRANS FIFO (0xE2E8..0xE2EB)
3481 // - Upper half : 8514/A registers mirrored at *E8 offsets
3482 if (s3_new_mmio_enabled()) {
3483 const u64 win_lo = 0x01000000ull;
3484 const u64 win_hi = 0x01020000ull;
3485 if (off >= win_lo && off < win_hi) {
3486 const u32 mmio_off = (u32)(off - win_lo);
3487 switch (dsize) {
3488 case 8: mem_w(mmio_off, (u8)(data)); return;
3489 case 16: mem_w(mmio_off, (u8)(data)); mem_w(mmio_off + 1, (u8)(data >> 8)); return;
3490 case 32: mem_w(mmio_off, (u8)(data)); mem_w(mmio_off + 1, (u8)(data >> 8));
3491 mem_w(mmio_off + 2, (u8)(data >> 16)); mem_w(mmio_off + 3, (u8)(data >> 24)); return;
3492 default: FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
3493 }
3494 }
3495 }
3496 if (off >= lfb_size) return;
3497
3498#ifdef S3_LFB_TRACE
3499 printf("%s: LFB W size=%d @%llx <= %08" PRIx64 " (off=%llx)\n",
3500 devid_string, dsize, (unsigned long long)address,
3501 data, (unsigned long long)(address));
3502#endif
3503 // Write little-endian into linear VRAM
3504 switch (dsize)
3505 {
3506 case 1: vga.memory[off] = (u8)data; break;
3507 case 2: *(u16*)(vga.memory + off) = (u16)data; break;
3508 case 4: *(u32*)(vga.memory + off) = (u32)data; break;
3509 case 8: {
3510 *(u32*)(vga.memory + off) = (u32)(data & 0xffffffffu);
3511 *(u32*)(vga.memory + off + 4) = (u32)(data >> 32);
3512 break;
3513 }
3514 default:
3515 for (int i = 0; i < dsize; ++i)
3516 vga.memory[off + i] = (u8)(data >> (i * 8));
3517 break;
3518 }
3519
3520 state.vga_mem_updated = 1;
3521 return;
3522 }
3523
3524 vga_device::WriteMem(index, address, dsize, data);
3525}
3526
3527
3528static inline u64 alpha_pio_phys_from_linear_base(u32 base)
3529{
3530 // Typhoon: PIO vs system memory is selected by physical bit<43>.
3531 // We map PCI memory space windows by setting that bit.
3532 // 0x0000_0800_0000_0000 is the simplest way to assert <43>.
3533 return U64(0x0000080000000000) | (u64)base;
3534}

3536void CS3Trio64::lfb_recalc_and_map()
3537{
3538 // BAR-only implementation: rely on BAR0 decoding in PCI core.
3539 // Just refresh cached enable/base/size; no RegisterMemory calls here.
3540 lfb_recalc_and_cache();
3541}

3543
3544u32 CS3Trio64::config_read_custom(int func, u32 address, int dsize, u32 cur)
3545{
3546 // Return stored bits, including literal values restored from older saves.
3547 // Shared address bits are reconciled when their PCI or CRTC register is written.
3548 return cur;
3549}
3550
3551void CS3Trio64::config_write_custom(int func, u32 address, int dsize,
3552 u32 old_data, u32 new_data, u32 raw)
3553{
3554 // Watch COMMAND (0x04..0x05) and BAR0 (0x10..0x13)..
3555 const bool is_command = (address == 0x04 || address == 0x05);
3556 const bool is_bar0 = (address >= 0x10 && address <= 0x13);
3557
3558 if (func == 0 && is_bar0 && !m_replaying_pci_state)
3559 {
3560 u32 lanes = 0;
3561 if (dsize == 8)
3562 lanes = 0xffU << ((address - 0x10) * 8);
3563 else if (dsize == 16 && (address & 1U) == 0)
3564 lanes = 0xffffU << ((address - 0x10) * 8);
3565 else if (dsize == 32 && address == 0x10)
3566 lanes = 0xffffffffU;
3567
3568 // DB014-B 17-7/19-4: BAR0[31:23] is shared with CR59/CR5A[7].
3569 // Keep unwritten bits and bits absent from the current BAR mask intact.
3570 const u32 shared = lanes & endian_32(pci_state.config_mask[0][4]) & 0xff800000U;
3571 if (shared)
3572 {
3573 const u32 bar0 = endian_32(pci_state.config_data[0][4]);
3574 s3.cr59 = u8((s3.cr59 & ~(shared >> 24)) | ((bar0 & shared) >> 24));
3575 s3.cr5a = u8((s3.cr5a & ~(shared >> 16)) | ((bar0 & shared) >> 16));
3576 lfb_base = (u32(s3.cr59) << 24) | (u32(s3.cr5a) << 16);
3577 }
3578 }
3579
3580 if (is_command || is_bar0) {
3581 lfb_recalc_and_cache();
3582 // Apply/unapply DEV_LFB mapping when MSE or BAR0 changes
3583 lfb_recalc_and_map();
3584 trace_lfb_if_changed(is_command ? "PCI COMMAND" : "PCI BAR0");
3585 }
3586}
3587
3588void CS3Trio64::trace_lfb_if_changed(const char* reason) {
3589 const bool linear_on = s3_lfb_enabled(m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x58), m_8514.ibm8514.advfunction_ctrl);
3590 const uint32_t sz = s3_lfb_size_from_cr58(m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x58));
3591 const uint32_t base = pci_bar0; // BAR-only base of truth
3592 const bool eff = pci_mem_enable && linear_on && (base != 0);
3593
3594 if (!lfb_trace_initialized ||
3595 eff != lfb_trace_enabled_prev ||
3596 base != lfb_trace_base_prev ||
3597 sz != lfb_trace_size_prev) {
3598
3599#ifdef S3_LFB_TRACE
3600 printf("%s: LFB %s - MSE=%d CR58=%02x ADVFUNC=%04x base=%08x size=%x (reason=%s)\n",
3601 devid_string, eff ? "ACTIVE(BAR)" : "INACTIVE(BAR)",
3602 (int)pci_mem_enable, m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x58), m_8514.ibm8514.advfunction_ctrl,
3603 base, sz, reason ? reason : "n/a");
3604#endif
3605
3606 lfb_trace_initialized = true;
3607 lfb_trace_enabled_prev = eff;
3608 lfb_trace_base_prev = base;
3609 lfb_trace_size_prev = sz;
3610 }
3611 if (eff) lfb_trace_needs_first_access_note = true;
3612}
3613
3614void CS3Trio64::lfb_recalc_and_cache()
3615{
3616 // COMMAND bit 1 (Memory Space Enable)
3617 const u32 cmd = config_read(0, 0x04, 16); // 16-bit read is enough for COMMAND
3618
3619 // BAR0: 32-bit memory BAR, mask off attribute bits
3620 const u32 bar0 = config_read(0, 0x10, 32) & 0xFFFFFFF0u;
3621
3622 pci_mem_enable = (cmd & 0x0002) != 0; // saner, i think...
3623
3624 pci_bar0 = bar0;
3625
3626 // Honor both linear enables and CR58 size; BAR0 remains the mapping base.
3627 const u8 cr58 = m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x58);
3628 lfb_base_ = bar0; // effective CPU-visible base = BAR0
3629 lfb_size_ = s3_lfb_size_from_cr58(cr58); // 64K/1M/2M/4M per Trio64
3630 lfb_enabled_ = pci_mem_enable && s3_lfb_enabled(cr58, m_8514.ibm8514.advfunction_ctrl) && (bar0 != 0);
3631}
