3634
3638void CS3Trio64::check_state()
3639{
3640 if (myThread && !myThread->isRunning())
3641 FAILURE(Thread, "S3 thread has died");
3642}
3643
3644static u32 s3_magic1 = 0x53338811;
3645static u32 s3_magic2 = 0x88115333;
3646static const u32 s3_video_magic = 0x53335632; // S3V2, complete graphics state
3647
3648// The surrounding system format identifies compatible snapshots.
3649// Per-record sizes additionally reject a different structure layout.
3650template <typename T>
3651static bool s3_write_record(FILE* f, const T& value)
3652{
3653 static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable<T>::value,
3654 "Saved graphics records must be trivially copyable");
3655 const u32 size = (u32)sizeof(T);
3656 return fwrite(&size, sizeof(size), 1, f) == 1 &&
3657 fwrite(&value, sizeof(value), 1, f) == 1;
3658}
3659
3660template <typename T>
3661static bool s3_read_record(FILE* f, T& value)
3662{
3663 static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable<T>::value,
3664 "Saved graphics records must be trivially copyable");
3665 u32 size = 0;
3666 return fread(&size, sizeof(size), 1, f) == 1 && size == sizeof(T) &&
3667 fread(&value, sizeof(value), 1, f) == 1;
3668}
3669
3673int CS3Trio64::SaveState(FILE* f)
3674{
3675 if (!f || !vga.memory || !vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
3676 return -1;
3677 advance_scan(cSystem->device_access_time());
3678 const int res = CPCIDevice::SaveState(f);
3679 if (res)
3680 return res;
3681
3682 // Only serialize guest state. The VRAM allocation belongs to this process.
3683 auto saved_state = state;
3684 auto saved_vga = vga;
3685 saved_state.memory = nullptr;
3686 saved_vga.memory = nullptr;
3687 const u8 io_state[] = { (u8)m_ioas,
3688 m_video_subsys_enable, m_setup_option_select_0102 };
3689 const u32 vram_size = (u32)vga.svga_intf.vram_size;
3690
3691 if (fwrite(&s3_magic1, sizeof(s3_magic1), 1, f) != 1 ||
3692 fwrite(&s3_video_magic, sizeof(s3_video_magic), 1, f) != 1 ||
3693 !s3_write_record(f, saved_state) || !s3_write_record(f, saved_vga) ||
3694 !s3_write_record(f, s3) || !s3_write_record(f, svga) ||
3695 !s3_write_record(f, m_8514.ibm8514) || !s3_write_record(f, io_state) ||
3696 !s3_write_record(f, m_scan) ||
3697 fwrite(&vram_size, sizeof(vram_size), 1, f) != 1 ||
3698 fwrite(vga.memory, vram_size, 1, f) != 1 ||
3699 fwrite(&s3_magic2, sizeof(s3_magic2), 1, f) != 1)
3700 {
3701 printf("%s: Could not save graphics state.\n", devid_string);
3702 return -1;
3703 }
3704 printf("%s: Graphics registers and %u bytes of VRAM saved.\n",
3705 devid_string, vram_size);
3706 return 0;
3707}
3708
3711
3712int CS3Trio64::RestoreState(FILE* f)
3713{
3714 if (!f || !vga.memory || !vga.svga_intf.vram_size)
3715 return -1;
3716 int res;
3717 {
3718 // Saved S3 aliases are loaded below. PCI replay must not normalize old
3719 // copies or mutate live graphics registers if the S3 section is rejected.
3720 struct ReplayGuard {
3721 bool& flag;
3722 bool previous;
3723 ~ReplayGuard() { flag = previous; }
3724 } guard{m_replaying_pci_state, m_replaying_pci_state};
3725 m_replaying_pci_state = true;
3726 res = CPCIDevice::RestoreState(f);
3727 }
3728 if (res)
3729 return res;
3730
3731 // Stage the complete graphics section so a short read or layout mismatch can't corrupt state.
3732 decltype(state) saved_state{};
3733 decltype(vga) saved_vga{};
3734 decltype(s3) saved_s3{};
3735 decltype(svga) saved_svga{};
3736 decltype(m_8514.ibm8514) saved_accel{};
3737 u8 io_state[3]{};
3738 ScanPosition saved_scan{};
3739 u32 magic = 0, video_magic = 0, vram_size = 0;
3740 if (fread(&magic, sizeof(magic), 1, f) != 1 || magic != s3_magic1 ||
3741 fread(&video_magic, sizeof(video_magic), 1, f) != 1 ||
3742 video_magic != s3_video_magic ||
3743 !s3_read_record(f, saved_state) || !s3_read_record(f, saved_vga) ||
3744 !s3_read_record(f, saved_s3) || !s3_read_record(f, saved_svga) ||
3745 !s3_read_record(f, saved_accel) || !s3_read_record(f, io_state) ||
3746 !s3_read_record(f, saved_scan) ||
3747 fread(&vram_size, sizeof(vram_size), 1, f) != 1 ||
3748 vram_size != vga.svga_intf.vram_size ||
3749 saved_vga.svga_intf.vram_size != vga.svga_intf.vram_size ||
3750 saved_state.memsize != state.memsize || io_state[0] > 1 ||
3751 (io_state[1] & ~0x18) || (io_state[2] & ~0x01) ||
3752 !std::isfinite(saved_scan.character) || saved_scan.character < 0.0 ||
3753 saved_scan.character >= 516.0 || saved_scan.line >= 4098 ||
3754 saved_scan.field > 1 ||
3755 (saved_scan.dclk_source != 0 && saved_scan.dclk_source != 1 &&
3756 saved_scan.dclk_source != 3))
3757 {
3758 printf("%s: Invalid or incompatible graphics state.\n", devid_string);
3759 return -1;
3760 }
3761
3762 std::vector<u8> saved_vram(vram_size);
3763 if (fread(saved_vram.data(), vram_size, 1, f) != 1 ||
3764 fread(&magic, sizeof(magic), 1, f) != 1 || magic != s3_magic2)
3765 {
3766 printf("%s: Incomplete graphics state.\n", devid_string);
3767 return -1;
3768 }
3769
3770 saved_state.memory = state.memory;
3771 saved_vga.memory = vga.memory;
3772 state = saved_state;
3773 vga = saved_vga;
3774 s3 = saved_s3;
3775 svga = saved_svga;
3776 m_8514.ibm8514 = saved_accel;
3777 m_ioas = io_state[0] != 0;
3778 m_video_subsys_enable = io_state[1];
3779 m_setup_option_select_0102 = io_state[2];
3780 m_scan = saved_scan;
3781 m_scan_time = cSystem->device_access_time();
3782 m_scan_initialized = true;
3783 // Preserve whether the caller stopped the VM. Normal System restore
3784 // resumes through start_threads; direct device restores remain runnable.
3785 memcpy(vga.memory, saved_vram.data(), vram_size);
3786
3787 // Rebuild host rendering caches from the restored registers.
3788 s3_define_video_mode();
3789 recompute_params();
3790 vga.dac.dirty = 1;
3791 if (m_gui_initialized)
3792 palette_update();
3793 else
3794 vga_device::palette_update();
3795 on_crtc_linear_regs_changed();
3796 state.last_bpp = 0;
3797 state.vga_mem_updated = true;
3798 m_frames_since_render = 0;
3799 m_last_refresh_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point{};
3800 printf("%s: Graphics registers and %u bytes of VRAM restored.\n",
3801 devid_string, vram_size);
3802 return 0;
3803}
3804
3808u32 CS3Trio64::mem_read(u32 address, int dsize)
3809{
3810 const u32 mv = s3_vram_mask(); // (memsize - 1)
3811 const u32 off = address & mv;
3812
3813 switch (dsize) {
3814 case 8:
3815 return (u32)vga.memory[off];
3816 case 16:
3817 return (u32)vga.memory[off] | ((u32)vga.memory[(off + 1) & mv] << 8);
3818 case 32:
3819 return (u32)vga.memory[off] | ((u32)vga.memory[(off + 1) & mv] << 8) | ((u32)vga.memory[(off + 2) & mv] << 16) | ((u32)vga.memory[(off + 3) & mv] << 24);
3820 default:
3821 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
3822 }
3823}
3824
3828void CS3Trio64::mem_write(u32 address, int dsize, u32 data)
3829{
3830 const u32 mv = s3_vram_mask(); // (memsize - 1)
3831 const u32 off = address & mv;
3832
3833 // Little-endian store into VRAM
3834 switch (dsize) {
3835 case 8:
3836 vga.memory[off] = (u8)data;
3837 break;
3838 case 16:
3839 vga.memory[off] = (u8)(data);
3840 vga.memory[(off + 1) & mv] = (u8)(data >> 8);
3841 break;
3842 case 32:
3843 vga.memory[off] = (u8)(data);
3844 vga.memory[(off + 1) & mv] = (u8)(data >> 8);
3845 vga.memory[(off + 2) & mv] = (u8)(data >> 16);
3846 vga.memory[(off + 3) & mv] = (u8)(data >> 24);
3847 break;
3848 default:
3849 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
3850 }
3851
3852 // Mark the affected tiles dirty so update() will serialize to the screen.
3853 state.vga_mem_updated = 1;
3854 if (vga.crtc.offset) {
3855 const unsigned nbytes = (dsize == 8) ? 1u : (dsize == 16 ? 2u : 4u);
3856 for (unsigned i = 0; i < nbytes; ++i) {
3857 const u32 p = (off + i) & mv;
3858 const u32 line = (vga.crtc.offset ? (p / vga.crtc.offset) : 0);
3859 const u32 col = (vga.crtc.offset ? (p % vga.crtc.offset) : 0);
3860 const unsigned xti = col / X_TILESIZE;
3861 const unsigned yti = line / Y_TILESIZE;
3862 }
3863 }
3864}
3865
3866
3872u32 CS3Trio64::legacy_read(u32 address, int dsize)
3873{
3874 // MMIO alias active ?
3875 if (s3.cr53 & 0x10) {
3876 const u32 base = s3_mmio_base_off(state);
3877 if (address >= base && address <= base + 0xFFFFu) {
3878 const u32 off = address - base;
3879 if (off < 0x8000) {
3880 // PIX_TRANS read — same as MAME
3881 switch (dsize) {
3882 case 8: return (u32)AccelIORead(0xE2E8);
3883 case 16: return (u32)AccelIORead(0xE2E8) | ((u32)AccelIORead(0xE2E9) << 8);
3884 case 32: return (u32)AccelIORead(0xE2E8) | ((u32)AccelIORead(0xE2E9) << 8) |
3885 ((u32)AccelIORead(0xE2EA) << 16) | ((u32)AccelIORead(0xE2EB) << 24);
3886 default: FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
3887 }
3888 }
3889 // Upper half: register reads via AccelIORead
3890 if (IsAccelPort(off))
3891 return AccelIORead(off, dsize);
3892 }
3893 }
3894
3895 u32 data = 0;
3896 switch (dsize)
3897 {
3898 case 32:
3899 data |= (u32)mem_r(address + 3) << 24;
3900 data |= (u32)mem_r(address + 2) << 16;
3901 [[fallthrough]];
3902 case 16:
3903 data |= (u32)mem_r(address + 1) << 8;
3904 [[fallthrough]];
3905 case 8:
3906 data |= (u32)mem_r(address + 0);
3907 break;
3908 default:
3909 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
3910 }
3911
3912 return data;
3913
3914}
3915
3917
3921 // --- Legacy VGA memory write with S3 MMIO alias support ---
3922void CS3Trio64::legacy_write(u32 address, int dsize, u32 data)
3923{
3924 switch (dsize) {
3925 case 8:
3926 mem_w(address, (u8)data);
3927 break;
3928
3929 case 16:
3930 mem_w(address, (u8)data);
3931 mem_w(address + 1, (u8)(data >> 8));
3932 break;
3933
3934 case 32:
3935 mem_w(address, (u8)data);
3936 mem_w(address + 1, (u8)(data >> 8));
3937 mem_w(address + 2, (u8)(data >> 16));
3938 mem_w(address + 3, (u8)(data >> 24));
3939 break;
3940
3941 default:
3942 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
3943 }
3944}
3945
3949u32 CS3Trio64::rom_read(u32 address, int dsize)
3950{
3951 if (dsize != 8 && dsize != 16 && dsize != 32)
3952 return 0;
3953
3954 // Preserve zero padding beyond the loaded image. Assemble bytes so reads
3955 // at the end of an image or the 64 KiB aperture never overrun the buffer.
3956 u32 data = 0;
3957 for (int byte = 0; byte < dsize / 8; ++byte)
3958 {
3959 const u64 offset = (u64)address + byte;
3960 if (offset < rom_max)
3961 data |= (u32)option_rom[offset] << (byte * 8);
3962 }
3963 return data;
3964}
3965
3967
3969u32 CS3Trio64::io_read(u32 address, int dsize)
3970{
3971 if (!io_access_enabled(address, false))
3972 return dsize == 8 ? 0xffU : dsize == 16 ? 0xffffU : 0xffffffffU;
3973 if (address == 0x0102)
3974 {
3975 // Only the option byte is implemented; unused read lanes float high.
3976 switch (dsize) {
3977 case 8: return m_setup_option_select_0102;
3978 case 16: return 0xff00U | m_setup_option_select_0102;
3979 case 32: return 0xffffff00U | m_setup_option_select_0102;
3980 default: FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
3981 }
3982 }
3983 u32 data = 0;
3984 // Always intercept S3 8514/A-style ports. If the port block is not enabled
3985 // yet (CR40 == 0), hardware behaves benignly: reads return bus pull-ups,
3986 // writes are ignored.
3987 if (IsAccelPort(address)) {
3988 const bool ge_enabled = (m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x40) & 0x01) != 0;
3989 if (!ge_enabled) {
3990 switch (dsize) {
3991 case 8: return 0xFF;
3992 case 16: return 0xFFFF;
3993 case 32: return 0xFFFFFFFF;
3994 default: FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
3995 }
3996 }
3997 return AccelIORead(address, dsize);
3998 }
3999
4000 if (dsize != 8)
4001 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
4002
4003
4004 switch (address)
4005 {
4006 case 0x3c2:
4007 data = read_b_3c2();
4008 break;
4009
4010 case 0x3c5:
4011 if (vga.sequencer.index > 0x08 && vga.sequencer.data[0x08] != 0x06)
4012 data = vga.sequencer.data[vga.sequencer.index];
4013 else
4014 data = sequencer_data_r(0);
4015 break;
4016
4017 case 0x3c9:
4018 data = ramdac_data_r(0);
4019 // DB014-B 14-49: valid palette reads expose six-bit components, even
4020 // from older saved bytes. Preserve undefined reads during write mode.
4021 if (vga.dac.read) data &= 0x3f;
4022 break;
4023
4024 case 0x3ca:
4025 data = read_b_3ca();
4026 break;
4027
4028 case 0x3ba:
4029 case 0x3da:
4030 {
4031 data = scan_status(cSystem->device_access_time());
4032 vga.attribute.state = 0; // ATC flip-flop reset
4033 break;
4034 }
4035
4036 case 0x3bb: /* Feature Control (mono) readback; mirror 3CA behavior */
4037 data = read_b_3ca();
4038 break;
4039 case 0x3db: /* Feature Control (color) readback; same treatment */
4040 data = read_b_3ca();
4041 break;
4042
4043 case 0x3b6:
4044 case 0x3b7:
4045 case 0x3b8:
4046 case 0x3b9:
4047 case 0x3d6:
4048 case 0x3d7:
4049 case 0x3d8:
4050 case 0x3d9:
4051 data = 0xFF; // open bus
4052 break;
4053
4054 default:
4055 {
4056 u8 value;
4057 if (vga_io_read(address, value))
4058 return value;
4059 printf("%s: Unhandled I/O port %x read.\n", devid_string, address);
4060 }
4061 }
4062
4063 return data;
4064}
4065
4071void CS3Trio64::io_write(u32 address, int dsize, u32 data)
4072{
4073 if (IsAccelPort(address) && !normal_access_enabled())
4074 return;
4075 // 8514/A-style accel window (S3 engine). Intercept first, and swallow writes
4076 // until CR40 enables the port block (to avoid falling through to VGA path).
4077 if (IsAccelPort(address)) {
4078 const bool ge_enabled = (m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x40) & 0x01) != 0;
4079 if (!ge_enabled) {
4080 // Ignore early probes safely (hardware no-op)
4081 return;
4082 }
4083#ifdef DEBUG_VGA
4084 printf("%s: Accelerator I/O write port=%04x size=%d data=%08x\n",
4085 devid_string, (unsigned)address, dsize, (unsigned)data);
4086#endif
4087 switch (dsize) {
4088 case 8:
4089 AccelIOWrite(address, (u8)data);
4090 return;
4091 case 16:
4092 if (address == 0x42e8) {
4093 // SUBSYS_CNTL has action fields: apply both lanes once.
4094 m_8514.ibm8514_subcontrol_w(u16(data));
4095 s3.mmio_42e8 = m_8514.ibm8514_subcontrol_r();
4096 return;
4097 }
4098 AccelIOWrite(address + 0, (u8)(data & 0xFF));
4099 AccelIOWrite(address + 1, (u8)((data >> 8) & 0xFF));
4100 return;
4101 case 32:
4102 AccelIOWrite(address + 0, (u8)((data >> 0) & 0xFF));
4103 AccelIOWrite(address + 1, (u8)((data >> 8) & 0xFF));
4104 AccelIOWrite(address + 2, (u8)((data >> 16) & 0xFF));
4105 AccelIOWrite(address + 3, (u8)((data >> 24) & 0xFF));
4106 return;
4107 default:
4108 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Unsupported dsize");
4109 }
4110 }
4111
4112 switch (dsize)
4113 {
4114 case 8:
4115 io_write_b(address, (u8)data);
4116 break;
4117
4118 case 16:
4119 io_write_b(address, (u8)data);
4120 io_write_b(address + 1, (u8)(data >> 8));
4121 break;
4122
4123 case 32:
4124#ifdef DEBUG_VGA_NOISY
4125 printf("%s: I/O write port=%04" PRIx32 " size=%d data=%08" PRIx32 "\n", devid_string, address, dsize, data);
4126#endif
4127 io_write_b(address, (u8)data);
4128 io_write_b(address + 1, (u8)(data >> 8));
4129 io_write_b(address + 2, (u8)(data >> 16));
4130 io_write_b(address + 3, (u8)(data >> 24));
4131 break;
4132
4133 default:
4134#ifdef DEBUG_VGA
4135 printf("%s: I/O write port=%04" PRIx32 " size=%d data=%08" PRIx32 "\n", devid_string, address, dsize, data);
4136#endif
4137 FAILURE(InvalidArgument, "Weird IO size");
4138 }
4139}
4140
4141// Shared by normal target writes and already-qualified passive writes.
4142// Keep access/lock checks at the caller so observers use captured eligibility.
4143void CS3Trio64::ramdac_write_b(u32 address, u8 data)
4144{
4145 switch (address)
4146 {
4147 case 0x3c6: ramdac_mask_w(0, data); break;
4148 case 0x3c7: ramdac_read_index_w(0, data); break;
4149 case 0x3c8: ramdac_write_index_w(0, data); break;
4150 case 0x3c9: ramdac_data_w(0, data); break;
4151 }
4152}
4153
4157void CS3Trio64::io_write_b(u32 address, u8 data)
4158{
4159 if (!io_access_enabled(address, true))
4160 return;
4161 // Finish elapsed scan time with the old registers before a timing write.
4162 // Every claimant in this PCI transaction receives the same sampled instant.
4163 if (address == 0x3c2 || address == 0x3c5 ||
4164 address == 0x3b5 || address == 0x3d5)
4165 advance_scan(cSystem->device_access_time());
4166 switch (address)
4167 {
4168 case 0x3c0:
4169 {
4170 bool was_index_phase = (vga.attribute.state == 0);
4171 // Snapshot previous video-enabled state BEFORE the MAME canonical write
4172 bool prev_ve = atc_video_enabled();
4173 atc_address_data_w(0, data);
4174 if (was_index_phase) {
4175 // Detect video enable/disable transitions from MAME canonical source
4176 bool new_ve = atc_video_enabled();
4177 if (!new_ve && prev_ve) {
4178 m_output.display().lock();
4179 m_output.display().clear_screen();
4180 m_output.display().unlock();
4181 }
4182 else if (new_ve && !prev_ve) {
4183 redraw_area(0, 0, old_iWidth, old_iHeight);
4184 }
4185 }
4186 break;
4187 }
4188
4189 case 0x3c2:
4190 write_b_3c2(data);
4191 m_ioas = bool(BIT(data, 0));
4192 break;
4193
4194 case 0x3c3:
4195 case 0x46E8:
4196 // Address selection and access were checked above; reserved bits read 0.
4197 m_video_subsys_enable = data & 0x18;
4198 break;
4199
4200 case 0x3c5:
4201 // PLL lock gate: SR09+ requires SR08 == 0x06
4202 if (vga.sequencer.index > 0x08 && vga.sequencer.data[0x08] != 0x06)
4203 break;
4204 // SR1A/SR1B: not in sequencer_map, but in 86box
4205 if (vga.sequencer.index == 0x1a) { s3.sr1a = data; break; }
4206 if (vga.sequencer.index == 0x1b) { s3.sr1b = data; break; }
4207 sequencer_data_w(0, data);
4208 break;
4209
4210 case 0x3c6:
4211 case 0x3c7:
4212 case 0x3c8:
4213 case 0x3c9:
4214 // CR33.4 locks all RAMDAC writes, including 3C7 (DB014-B 12-2).
4215 if (!(s3.cr33 & 0x10))
4216 ramdac_write_b(address, data);
4217 break;
4218
4219 case 0x3b4:
4220 case 0x3d4:
4221 vga.crtc.index = data & 0x7f;
4222 break;
4223
4224 case 0x3bb:
4225 break;
4226
4227 case 0x3b6:
4228 case 0x3b7:
4229 case 0x3b8:
4230 case 0x3b9:
4231 case 0x3d6:
4232 case 0x3d7:
4233 case 0x3d8:
4234 case 0x3d9:
4235 // Dead ports — 32-bit writes to the CRTC pair (3D4/3D5) spill here.
4236 // Real hardware silently ignores them.
4237 break;
4238
4239 case 0x0102:
4240 m_setup_option_select_0102 = data & 0x01;
4241 break;
4242
4243 default:
4244 if (vga_io_write(address, data))
4245 break;
4246#ifdef DEBUG_VGA
4247 printf("%s: Unhandled I/O write port=%04x data=%02x\n", devid_string, address, data);
4248#endif
4249 FAILURE_1(NotImplemented, "Unhandled port %x write", address);
4250 }
4251}
4252
4288void CS3Trio64::write_b_3c2(u8 value)
4289{
4290 // ES40 extension: CR34 bit7 locks clock select bits
4291 if (m_crtc_map.read_byte(0x34) & 0x80) {
4292 // Preserve current clock_select (bits 3:2), take everything else from value
4293 value = (value & ~0x0C) | (vga.miscellaneous_output & 0x0C);
4294 }
4295
4296 // MAME canonical store (flat byte)
4297 vga.miscellaneous_output = value;
4298 load_dclk();
4299
4300#ifdef DEBUG_VGA_NOISY
4301 printf("%s: Miscellaneous output=%02x color=%u RAM=%u clock=%u "
4302 "high_bank=%u hsync_polarity=%u vsync_polarity=%u\n",
4303 devid_string, value, unsigned(BIT(value, 0)), unsigned(BIT(value, 1)), unsigned((value >> 2) & 3),
4304 unsigned(BIT(value, 5)), unsigned(BIT(value, 6)), unsigned(BIT(value, 7)));
4305#endif
4306}
4307
4322u8 CS3Trio64::read_b_3c2()
4323{
4324 u8 res = 0x60; // is VGA (bits 5-6 set)
4325
4326 // Sense bit readback: select which of 4 sense switches based on clock select
4327 // MAME: const u8 sense_bit = (3 - (vga.miscellaneous_output >> 2)) & 3;
4328 // if(BIT(m_input_sense->read(), sense_bit)) res |= 0x10;
4329 const u8 sense_bit = (3 - ((vga.miscellaneous_output >> 2) & 3)) & 3;
4330 if (BIT(0x0F, sense_bit)) // all sense pins active
4331 res |= 0x10;
4332
4333 res |= vga.crtc.irq_latch << 7;
4334 return res;
4335}

4355
4356void CS3Trio64::update(void)
4357{
4358 unsigned iWidth = 0, iHeight = 0;
4359
4360 /* no screen update necessary
4361 Trio32/Trio64: SR0 reset bits are not functional
4362 Gate on ATC video enable and SR1 "Screen Off" */
4363 // Setup/sleep controls CPU access; existing video output continues (14-47).
4364 if (!atc_video_enabled())
4365 return;
4366
4367 const bool screen_off = (vga.sequencer.data[1] & 0x20) != 0; // SR1 bit5
4368 if (screen_off)
4369 return;
4370
4371 auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
4372 auto elapsed_ms = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
4373 now - m_last_refresh_time).count();
4374
4375 if (elapsed_ms < (long long)timing.refresh_interval_ms)
4376 return;
4377 m_last_refresh_time = now;
4378
4379 const uint8_t cur_mode = pc_vga_choosevideomode();
4380
4381 if (cur_mode == SCREEN_OFF)
4382 {
4383 state.vga_mem_updated = 0;
4384 return;
4385 }
4386
4387 // Dirty-gate: re-rasterize + re-upload only when something visible changed. vga_mem_updated covers
4388 // VRAM + CRTC text-cursor + palette + mode writes; the S3 hardware cursor (mode/pos/data-addr) is not
4389 // flagged, so fold it into a signature. Force a refresh every few frames so the cursor / blinking text
4390 // still animate on an otherwise static screen; tick_frame() keeps the blink counter advancing on the
4391 // skip path so blink timing stays correct.
4392 const int kBlinkRefreshFrames = 8; // >= 2x the ~1.9 Hz VGA blink toggle at a 60 Hz refresh
4393 const uint64_t cursor_sig = ((uint64_t) s3.cursor_mode << 56)
4394 | ((uint64_t) s3.cursor_start_addr << 24)
4395 | ((uint64_t) (s3.cursor_x & 0x7FF) << 12)
4396 | (uint64_t) (s3.cursor_y & 0x7FF);
4397 if (!state.vga_mem_updated && cursor_sig == m_last_cursor_sig
4398 && ++m_frames_since_render < kBlinkRefreshFrames)
4399 {
4400 screen().tick_frame(); // keep cursor/text-blink timing alive while skipping the render
4401 return;
4402 }
4403 m_frames_since_render = 0;
4404 m_last_cursor_sig = cursor_sig;
4405
4406 vga.crtc.start_addr = vga.crtc.start_addr_latch; // FIXME: Figure out proper handling, but makes BSD happy again....
4407 vga.attribute.pel_shift = vga.attribute.pel_shift_latch;
4408
4409 get_display_size(iWidth, iHeight);
4410
4411 if (iWidth == 0 || iHeight == 0)
4412 return;
4413
4414 // Update screen shim's visible area
4415 screen().set_visible_area(iWidth, iHeight);
4416
4417 // Ensure bitmap is large enough
4418 m_render_bitmap.allocate(iWidth, iHeight);
4419
4420 // Render via MAME's screen_update pipeline
4421 rectangle clip = m_render_bitmap.cliprect();
4422 screen_update(screen(), m_render_bitmap, clip);
4423
4424 // Tick the frame counter (for cursor blink)
4425 screen().tick_frame();
4426
4427 // MAME always produces ARGB32 — tell SDL we're in 32bpp mode.
4428 if (state.last_bpp != 32 || iWidth != old_iWidth || iHeight != old_iHeight)
4429 {
4430 m_output.display().dimension_update(iWidth, iHeight, 0, 0, 32);
4431 old_iWidth = iWidth;
4432 old_iHeight = iHeight;
4433 state.last_bpp = 32;
4434 }
4435
4436 m_output.display().graphics_frame_update(m_render_bitmap.raw(), iWidth, iHeight);
4437
4438 state.vga_mem_updated = 0;
4439}
4440
4441// Active display from the display-end registers, which already carry the CR07
4442// and S3 CR5D/CR5E overflow bits; char clocks scaled by the colour-mode divisor.
4443void CS3Trio64::get_display_size(unsigned& width, unsigned& height)
4444{
4445 width = height = 0;
4446 if (!vga.crtc.horz_disp_end || !vga.crtc.vert_disp_end)
4447 return;
4448
4449 const unsigned char_clocks = GRAPHIC_MODE ? 8 : VGA_CH_WIDTH;
4450 const unsigned divisor = timing.divisor > 0 ? (unsigned)timing.divisor : 1;
4451 width = (vga.crtc.horz_disp_end + 1u) * char_clocks / divisor;
4452 height = LINES;
4453}

4455inline uint32_t CS3Trio64::s3_vram_mask() const
4456{
4457 const uint32_t sz = vga.svga_intf.vram_size ? vga.svga_intf.vram_size : (8u * 1024u * 1024u);
4458 return sz - 1u;

4460
4461void CS3Trio64::palette_update()
4462{
4463 vga_device::palette_update();
4464
4465 for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
4466 // pal6bit: expand 6-bit color to 8-bit
4467 u8 r = (vga.dac.color[3 * (i & vga.dac.mask) + 0] & 0x3f);
4468 u8 g = (vga.dac.color[3 * (i & vga.dac.mask) + 1] & 0x3f);
4469 u8 b = (vga.dac.color[3 * (i & vga.dac.mask) + 2] & 0x3f);
4470 // Expand 6-bit to 8-bit: (val << 2) | (val >> 4)
4471 r = (r << 2) | (r >> 4);
4472 g = (g << 2) | (g >> 4);
4473 b = (b << 2) | (b >> 4);
4474 m_output.display().palette_change((unsigned)i, (unsigned)r, (unsigned)g, (unsigned)b);
4475 }
4476}

4485// Draws the 64x64 S3 hardware graphics cursor over a pre-rendered framebuffer.
4486// Supports Windows mode and X11 mode (CR55 bit 4), and all color depths.
4487void CS3Trio64::s3_draw_hardware_cursor(
4488 uint32_t* pixels, int pitch_px,
4489 int clip_width, int clip_height,
4490 uint8_t cur_mode)
4491{
4492 // Only draw if cursor is enabled
4493 if (!(s3.cursor_mode & 0x01))
4494 return;
4495
4496 // Cursor only works in VGA or SVGA modes
4497 if (cur_mode == SCREEN_OFF || cur_mode == TEXT_MODE ||
4498 cur_mode == MONO_MODE || cur_mode == CGA_MODE ||
4499 cur_mode == EGA_MODE)
4500 return;
4501
4502 uint16_t cx = s3.cursor_x & 0x07FF;
4503 uint16_t cy = s3.cursor_y & 0x07FF;
4504
4505 // Start address is in units of 1024 bytes
4506 uint32_t src = (uint32_t)s3.cursor_start_addr * 1024;
4507
4508 // Decode foreground/background colors
4509 uint32_t bg_col, fg_col;
4510
4511 auto decode_rgb16 = [](const uint8_t* raw) -> uint32_t {
4512 uint32_t datax = raw[0] | (raw[1] << 8);
4513 int r = (datax & 0xF800) >> 11;
4514 int g = (datax & 0x07E0) >> 5;
4515 int b = (datax & 0x001F) >> 0;
4516 r = (r << 3) | (r & 0x7);
4517 g = (g << 2) | (g & 0x3);
4518 b = (b << 3) | (b & 0x7);
4519 return 0xFF000000u | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
4520 };
4521
4522 auto decode_rgb24 = [](const uint8_t* raw) -> uint32_t {
4523 uint32_t datax = raw[0] | (raw[1] << 8) | (raw[2] << 16);
4524 int r = (datax & 0xFF0000) >> 16;
4525 int g = (datax & 0x00FF00) >> 8;
4526 int b = (datax & 0x0000FF) >> 0;
4527 return 0xFF000000u | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
4528 };
4529
4530 switch (cur_mode)
4531 {
4532 case RGB15_MODE:
4533 case RGB16_MODE:
4534 bg_col = decode_rgb16(s3.cursor_bg);
4535 fg_col = decode_rgb16(s3.cursor_fg);
4536 break;
4537
4538 case RGB24_MODE:
4539 case RGB32_MODE:
4540 bg_col = decode_rgb24(s3.cursor_bg);
4541 fg_col = decode_rgb24(s3.cursor_fg);
4542 break;
4543
4544 case RGB8_MODE:
4545 default:
4546 bg_col = pen(s3.cursor_bg[0]);
4547 fg_col = pen(s3.cursor_fg[0]);
4548 break;
4549 }
4550
4551 // Draw the 64x64 cursor bitmap
4552 // Cursor data: 64 rows, each row = 16 bytes (4 words of 16 bits A + 16 bits B)
4553 // Pattern origin offset from CR4E/CR4F
4554 const int pat_x = s3.cursor_pattern_x & 0x3F;
4555 const int pat_y = s3.cursor_pattern_y & 0x3F;
4556
4557 for (int y = 0; y < 64; y++)
4558 {
4559 int screen_y = cy + y - pat_y;
4560 if (screen_y < 0 || screen_y >= clip_height)
4561 {
4562 // Still need to advance src through the row's cursor data
4563 // Each row: 4 groups of 4 bytes = 16 bytes
4564 // But we advance per-group below, so just skip
4565 // We need 4 groups * 4 bytes = 16 bytes per row
4566 src += 16; // skip this row's data
4567 continue;
4568 }
4569
4570 uint32_t* dst = pixels + (screen_y * pitch_px);
4571 uint32_t row_src = src;
4572
4573 for (int x = 0; x < 64; x++)
4574 {
4575 // Each 16-pixel group uses 4 bytes: 2 bytes for A-plane, 2 for B-plane
4576 // Bit extraction from MAME:
4577 uint16_t bita = (vga.memory[(row_src + 1) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size] |
4578 ((vga.memory[(row_src + 0) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size]) << 8))
4579 >> (15 - (x % 16));
4580 uint16_t bitb = (vga.memory[(row_src + 3) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size] |
4581 ((vga.memory[(row_src + 2) % vga.svga_intf.vram_size]) << 8))
4582 >> (15 - (x % 16));
4583 uint8_t val = ((bita & 0x01) << 1) | (bitb & 0x01);
4584
4585 int screen_x = cx + x - pat_x;
4586 if (screen_x >= 0 && screen_x < clip_width)
4587 {
4588 if (s3.extended_dac_ctrl & 0x10)
4589 {
4590 // X11 mode
4591 switch (val)
4592 {
4593 case 0x00: /* no change - transparent */ break;
4594 case 0x01: /* no change - transparent */ break;
4595 case 0x02: dst[screen_x] = bg_col; break;
4596 case 0x03: dst[screen_x] = fg_col; break;
4597 }
4598 }
4599 else
4600 {
4601 // Windows mode
4602 switch (val)
4603 {
4604 case 0x00: dst[screen_x] = bg_col; break;
4605 case 0x01: dst[screen_x] = fg_col; break;
4606 case 0x02: /* screen data - no change */ break;
4607 case 0x03: dst[screen_x] = ~(dst[screen_x]); break; // invert
4608 }
4609 }
4610 }
4611
4612 // Advance source pointer every 16 pixels
4613 if (x % 16 == 15)
4614 row_src += 4;
4615 }
4616 src = row_src; // advance to next row
4617 }
4618}
